import { addPlayerExp } from './player-stats.js';
import { statMultiplier } from './combat-stats.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// World-space records survive camera scrolling and map switches for this session.
const drops = new Map();
let nextId = 0;
const iconWidth = 35; // EDIT drop size: 25% larger; roughly 30% of Plana's visible height.
const pickupRadius = 26; // EDIT walk-over collection radius in world pixels.
export const pickupMagnet = { acceleration: 1200, maxSpeed: 650 }; // Pixels/secÂ² and pixels/sec.
export const creditDropChance = 1 / 90; // EDIT occasional credit chance (~1.11%).
export const secretNoteDropChance = 0.001; // 0.1% per defeated enemy.
// EDIT elite bonus rewards independently of normal-enemy drop rates.
export const eliteLoot = { creditChance: 0.2, creditAmount: 5, noteChance: 0.01 };
const lootTotals = { credits: 0, secretTechNotes: 0 }; // Shared across avatar swaps.
export const dropScatter = { duration: 0.28, minDistance: 40, maxDistance: 80, hopHeight: 18 };

/** Launch loot toward a random nearby landing spot with a small airborne hop. */
export function launchDrop(drop, random = Math.random) {
  const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const distance = dropScatter.minDistance + random() * (dropScatter.maxDistance - dropScatter.minDistance);
  drop.scatter = { elapsed: 0, x: drop.x, y: drop.y,
    dx: Math.cos(angle) * distance, dy: Math.sin(angle) * distance,
    rotation: drop.rotation, spin: (random() - 0.5) * Math.PI };
  return drop;
}

/** Animate the outward toss before enabling pickup attraction or collection. */
export function updateDropScatter(drop, delta) {
  if (!drop.scatter) return false;
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  flight.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const t = Math.min(1, flight.elapsed / dropScatter.duration);
  const progress = 1 - (1 - t) ** 2;
  drop.x = flight.x + flight.dx * progress;
  drop.y = flight.y + flight.dy * progress;
  drop.lift = 4 * dropScatter.hopHeight * t * (1 - t);
  drop.rotation = flight.rotation + flight.spin * progress;
  if (t === 1) { delete drop.scatter; drop.lift = 0; }
  return true;
}

/** Read session inventory; spending and attack upgrades will be implemented later. */
export function getLootTotals() {
  return { ...lootTotals };
}

/** Inspect all ground loot, including credits and Secret Tech Notes. */
export function getGroundLoot() {
  return [...drops.values()];
}

/** Discard uncollected loot on a map change; collected inventory remains intact. */
export function clearGroundLoot() {
  drops.clear();
}

/** Spawn a specific ground pickup for repeatable admin testing. */
export function spawnTestDrop(kind, value, x, y) {
  if (!['exp', 'credits', 'secretTechNotes'].includes(kind)) return;
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 1) return;
  const drop = { id: ++nextId, kind, value: Math.floor(value),
    tier: reportTier(value), x, y, rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop);
  return drop;
}

/** Apply one pickup's reward without coupling inventory to the controlled avatar. */
function collectDrop(drop, player) {
  drops.delete(drop.id);
  if (drop.kind === 'exp') addPlayerExp(player, drop.value);
  else lootTotals[drop.kind] += drop.value;
}

/** Roll independent bonus drops, allowing both rewards on the same defeat. */
export function dropEnemyLoot(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  const credits = random() < (enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.creditChance : creditDropChance);
  const note = random() < (enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.noteChance : secretNoteDropChance);
  for (const [kind, awarded] of [['credits', credits], ['secretTechNotes', note]]) {
    if (!awarded) continue;
    const drop = {
      id: ++nextId, kind, value: kind === 'credits' && enemy.elite ? eliteLoot.creditAmount : 1,
      x: enemy.x,
      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
    };
    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
    launchDrop(drop, random);
  }
}

/** Select artwork by EXP value; the highest supplied file is named Report 3. */
export function reportTier(value) {
  return value >= 50 ? 3 : value >= 21 ? 2 : value >= 11 ? 1 : 0;
}

/** Roll a report's EXP value: elites get Report 1 (80%) or Report 2 (20%). */
export function rollEnemyExp(random = Math.random, elite = false) {
  if (elite) {
    return random() < 0.8 ? 11 + Math.floor(random() * 10) : 21 + Math.floor(random() * 29);
  }
  const uncommon = random() >= 0.9;
  return uncommon ? 11 + Math.floor(random() * 10) : 1 + Math.floor(random() * 9);
}

/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
export function getExpDrops() {
  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
}

export const eliteExpRewards = { count: 5, minimumTotal: 150 };

/** Top up low elite rolls, preferring existing high tiers before promoting others. */
export function rollEliteReports(random = Math.random, override) {
  const values = Array.from({ length: eliteExpRewards.count }, () =>
    Math.max(11, Math.floor(override ?? rollEnemyExp(random, true))));
  let deficit = eliteExpRewards.minimumTotal - values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const indices = values.map((_, index) => index).sort((a, b) => values[b] - values[a]);
  for (const index of indices) {
    if (deficit <= 0) break;
    const extra = Math.min(deficit, Math.max(0, 49 - values[index]));
    values[index] += extra;
    deficit -= extra;
  }
  return values;
}

/** Drop five reports totaling at least 150 EXP for elites, otherwise one. */
export function dropEnemyExp(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  const reports = [];
  const values = enemy.elite ? rollEliteReports(random, enemy.expReward)
    : [Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? rollEnemyExp(random))];
  for (const value of values) {
    const drop = dropExpReport(enemy, random, value);
    if (drop) reports.push(drop);
  }
  return reports;
}

/** Create one scattered report; explicit admin EXP overrides remain supported. */
function dropExpReport(enemy, random, value) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
  const drop = {
    id: ++nextId, kind: 'exp', value, tier: reportTier(value), x: enemy.x,
    y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
    rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
  };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop, random);
  return drop;
}

/** Load report graphics once and provide collection/rendering for the preview. */
export function createExpPickups(getPlayer) {
  const lootStatus = document.querySelector('#player-loot-status');
  const tools = document.querySelector('#loot-tools');
  if (tools) {
    tools.querySelectorAll('[data-loot-action]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const player = getPlayer();
        const action = button.dataset.lootAction;
        if (action === 'clear') drops.clear();
        else if (action === 'collect') {
          for (const drop of drops.values()) collectDrop(drop, player);
        } else if (action === 'reset') {
          lootTotals.credits = 0;
          lootTotals.secretTechNotes = 0;
        } else {
          const amount = Number(tools.querySelector('[name="loot-value"]').value);
          spawnTestDrop(action, Math.min(1000000, amount), player.x + 80,
            player.y + (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding);
        }
      });
    });
  }
  const icons = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, tier) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.src = `../sprites/icons/Exp_Report_${tier}.png`;
    return image;
  });
  const ready = Promise.all(icons.map(image => image.decode()));
  const creditIcon = new Image();
  creditIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/credits.png';
  const creditReady = creditIcon.decode();
  const noteIcon = new Image();
  noteIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/Ultimate_Skill_Book.png';
  const noteReady = noteIcon.decode();

  /** Sweep direct pickups, then accelerate attracted loot toward the active avatar. */
  function update(player, previous, delta = 0) {
    const footOffset = (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
    const start = { x: previous.x, y: previous.y + footOffset };
    const end = { x: player.x, y: player.y + footOffset };
    const dx = end.x - start.x, dy = end.y - start.y;
    const lengthSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      // Let the toss finish so contact kills cannot instantly swallow the drops.
      if (updateDropScatter(drop, delta)) continue;
      const fraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
        ((drop.x - start.x) * dx + (drop.y - start.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
      const sweptDistance = Math.hypot(drop.x - start.x - dx * fraction, drop.y - start.y - dy * fraction);
      if (drop.pickupTarget !== player) {
        drop.attracted = false;
        drop.walkOverPickup = false;
        drop.pickupSpeed = 0;
        drop.pickupTarget = player;
      }
      // Walking over loot begins the same center-bound flight as a magnet pickup.
      // Arona can finish these pickups without gaining any attraction radius.
      if (sweptDistance <= pickupRadius) drop.walkOverPickup = true;
      const range = Math.max(0, player.pickupRange || 0) * statMultiplier(player, 'pickupPercent');
      if (!range && !drop.walkOverPickup) {
        // Swapping to an avatar without attraction stops pending magnets immediately.
        drop.attracted = false;
        drop.pickupSpeed = 0;
        continue;
      }
      // Magnet detection follows the sprite center; walk-over detection stays at feet.
      const centerFraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
        ((drop.x - previous.x) * dx + (drop.y - previous.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
      const centerDistance = Math.hypot(drop.x - previous.x - dx * centerFraction,
        drop.y - previous.y - dy * centerFraction);
      if (drop.walkOverPickup || centerDistance <= range) drop.attracted = true;
      if (drop.attracted) {
        const targetX = player.x - drop.x, targetY = player.y - drop.y;
        const distance = Math.hypot(targetX, targetY);
        const time = Math.max(0, delta);
        const speed = drop.pickupSpeed || 0;
        drop.pickupSpeed = Math.min(pickupMagnet.maxSpeed, speed + pickupMagnet.acceleration * time);
        const travel = Math.min(distance, (speed + drop.pickupSpeed) / 2 * time);
        if (distance > 0) {
          drop.x += targetX / distance * travel;
          drop.y += targetY / distance * travel;
        }
        // Rendered beneath actors: disappear only on arrival at the actual center.
        if (distance - travel <= 0.5) collectDrop(drop, player);
      }
    }
    if (lootStatus) lootStatus.textContent = `Credits: ${lootTotals.credits} | Secret Tech Notes: ${lootTotals.secretTechNotes} | Ground drops: ${drops.size}`;
  }

  /** Draw only visible reports beneath actors, keeping their orientation fixed. */
  function draw(context, camera, width, height) {
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      const x = drop.x - camera.x, y = drop.y - camera.y - (drop.lift || 0);
      if (x < -iconWidth || y < -iconWidth || x > width + iconWidth || y > height + iconWidth) continue;
      const icon = drop.kind === 'exp' ? icons[drop.tier]
        : drop.kind === 'credits' ? creditIcon : noteIcon;
      const sourceWidth = icon.naturalWidth;
      const sourceHeight = icon.naturalHeight;
      if (!sourceWidth) continue;
      const iconHeight = iconWidth * sourceHeight / sourceWidth;
      context.save();
      context.translate(x, y);
      context.rotate(drop.rotation);
      context.drawImage(icon, -iconWidth / 2, -iconHeight / 2, iconWidth, iconHeight);
      context.restore();
    }
  }
  return { ready: Promise.all([ready, creditReady, noteReady]), update, draw, clear: clearGroundLoot };
}
import { showDamageNumber } from './damage-numbers.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, defaultCombatStats } from './combat-stats.js';

// EDIT the starting cost and base term of the rounded per-level increase.
export const startingLevelExp = 50;
export const expIncreasePerLevel = 15;

/** Add round(15 + currentLevel / 2) to the next requirement on each level-up. */
export function experienceForLevel(level) {
  const current = Math.max(1, Math.floor(level));
  // Sum rounded increments for levels 1..current-1 without a per-level loop.
  const steps = current - 1;
  const pairs = Math.floor(steps / 2);
  const roundedHalves = pairs * (pairs + 1) + (steps % 2 ? pairs + 1 : 0);
  return startingLevelExp + expIncreasePerLevel * steps + roundedHalves;
}

/** Initialize session stats once; Development defaults to invincibility on. */
export function ensurePlayerStats(character) {
  character.level ??= 1;
  character.exp ??= 0;
  character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
  character.maxHp ??= 100;
  character.hp ??= character.maxHp;
  character.invincible ??= true;
  ensureCombatStats(character);
  return character;
}

/** Add experience, retaining overflow and supporting multiple level-ups per award. */
export function addPlayerExp(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  character.exp += Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(amount));
  while (character.exp >= character.maxExp) {
    character.exp -= character.maxExp;
    character.level++;
    character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
    character.hp = character.maxHp; // Every level-up fully restores health.
  }
}

/** Death protection allows zero HP; use this check when handling player defeat. */
export function isPlayerDefeated(character) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  return character.hp <= 0 && !character.invincible;
}

/** Apply damage and its flash even while invincible, preserving HP bounds. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const previous = character.hp;
  character.hp = Math.max(0, character.hp - Math.floor(amount));
  if (character.hp < previous) {
    character.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
    showDamageNumber(character, previous - character.hp, true);
  }
  return character.hp < previous;
}

/** Heal without exceeding maximum HP; works while invincible. */
export function healPlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0) {
    character.hp = Math.min(character.maxHp, character.hp + Math.floor(amount));
  }
}

// Persistent-in-session enemy state is separate from disposable background tiles.
// Future enemy spawning should register world coordinates here, never screen X/Y.
import { dropEnemyExp, dropEnemyLoot } from './exp-drops.js';
import { beginEnemyDeath } from './enemy-death.js';
import { showDamageNumber } from './damage-numbers.js';
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

export const enemyPopulationSettings = { limit: 400, despawnDistance: 100, trimAt: 0.9, trimTo: 0.7 };

/** Boss identity is explicit, never inferred from an elite's enlarged sprite. */
export function isBossEnemy(enemy) {
  return enemy.boss === true || enemy.type === 'iroha' || enemy.type === 'shiroko';
}

/** Measure distance from sprite edges to the gameplay viewport rectangle. */
export function enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height) {
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2;
  const dx = Math.max(camera.x - (enemy.x + radius), enemy.x - radius - camera.x - width, 0);
  const dy = Math.max(camera.y - (enemy.y + radius), enemy.y - radius - camera.y - height, 0);
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}

const enemies = new Map();
const spawnListeners = new Set();
const defeatListeners = new Set();
let killCount = 0;

/** Observe real spawns/defeats; cleanup removals never emit these events. */
export function onEnemySpawn(listener) {
  spawnListeners.add(listener);
  return () => spawnListeners.delete(listener);
}
export function onEnemyDefeat(listener) {
  defeatListeners.add(listener);
  return () => defeatListeners.delete(listener);
}

/** Count confirmed defeats for this session; admin removal does not count. */
export function getKillCount() {
  return killCount;
}

/** Return all session records, including enemies outside the camera view. */
export function getAllEnemies() {
  return [...enemies.values()];
}

/** Explicitly clear the test population without affecting player state. */
export function clearEnemies() {
  enemies.clear();
}

/** Add or update an enemy's state without tying its lifetime to camera visibility. */
export function rememberEnemy(id, state) {
  const existed = enemies.has(id);
  const enemy = { ...enemies.get(id), ...state, id };
  enemies.set(id, enemy);
  if (!existed) for (const listener of spawnListeners) listener(enemy);
  return enemy;
}

/** Read a remembered enemy even after its background tile has left the screen. */
export function getEnemy(id) {
  return enemies.get(id);
}

/** Apply damage and trigger a brief sprite pulse; remove defeated test enemies. */
export function damageEnemy(id, amount, source, hitType = 'normal') {
  const enemy = enemies.get(id);
  if (!enemy || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - amount);
  showDamageNumber(enemy, amount, false, hitType); // Include overkill and crit styling.
  enemy.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
  if (enemy.hp === 0) {
    const bossesAliveBefore = [...enemies.values()].filter(isBossEnemy).length;
    killCount++;
    dropEnemyExp(enemy);
    dropEnemyLoot(enemy);
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source);
    enemies.delete(id);
    for (const listener of defeatListeners) listener({ enemy, bossesAliveBefore });
  }
  return enemy;
}

/** Return enemies near the viewport for future rendering; retain all other records. */
export function getVisibleEnemies(cameraX, viewportWidth, margin = 160) {
  return [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy =>
    enemy.x >= cameraX - margin &&
    enemy.x <= cameraX + viewportWidth + margin
  );
}

/** Select artwork by EXP value; the highest supplied file is named Report 3. */
export function reportTier(value) {
  return value >= 50 ? 3 : value >= 21 ? 2 : value >= 11 ? 1 : 0;
}

/** Roll a report's EXP value: elites get Report 1 (80%) or Report 2 (20%). */
export function rollEnemyExp(random = Math.random, elite = false) {
  if (elite) {
    return random() < 0.8 ? 11 + Math.floor(random() * 10) : 21 + Math.floor(random() * 29);
  }
  const uncommon = random() >= 0.9;
  return uncommon ? 11 + Math.floor(random() * 10) : 1 + Math.floor(random() * 9);
}

/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
export function getExpDrops() {
  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
}

export const eliteExpRewards = { count: 5, minimumTotal: 150 };

/** Top up low elite rolls, preferring existing high tiers before promoting others. */
export function rollEliteReports(random = Math.random, override) {
  const values = Array.from({ length: eliteExpRewards.count }, () =>
    Math.max(11, Math.floor(override ?? rollEnemyExp(random, true))));
  let deficit = eliteExpRewards.minimumTotal - values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const indices = values.map((_, index) => index).sort((a, b) => values[b] - values[a]);
  for (const index of indices) {
    if (deficit <= 0) break;
    const extra = Math.min(deficit, Math.max(0, 49 - values[index]));
    values[index] += extra;
    deficit -= extra;
  }
  return values;
}

// EDIT boss reward amount, minimum report count, and outward burst radius here.
export const bossExpRewards = { minLevels: 0.8, maxLevels: 1.5, minimumReports: 50,
  minDistance: 100, maxDistance: 230 };

/** Split a level-scaled boss reward into positive reports without losing EXP. */
export function rollBossReports(player, random = Math.random) {
  const requirement = experienceForLevel(player?.level || 1);
  const minimum = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports,
    Math.ceil(requirement * bossExpRewards.minLevels));
  const maximum = Math.max(minimum, Math.floor(requirement * bossExpRewards.maxLevels));
  const total = minimum + Math.floor(random() * (maximum - minimum + 1));
  const count = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total / 49));
  const base = Math.floor(total / count), remainder = total % count;
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));
}

/** Standard Mob EXP scales with the active player; round halves upward. */
export function standardMobExp(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.floor(player?.level || 1));
  return Math.round(3 + level / 2);
}

/** Drop a full-circle boss burst, five elite reports, or one ordinary report. */
export function dropEnemyExp(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  const reports = [];
  const boss = enemy.boss === true || ['iroha', 'shiroko'].includes(enemy.type);
  const values = boss ? rollBossReports(getActivePlayer(), random) : enemy.elite ? rollEliteReports(random, enemy.expReward)
    : [Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? (enemy.type === 'mob'
      ? standardMobExp(getActivePlayer()) : rollEnemyExp(random)))];
  const burstAngle = boss ? random() * Math.PI * 2 : 0;
  for (const [index, value] of values.entries()) {
    const drop = dropExpReport(enemy, random, value);
    if (!drop) continue;
    if (boss) {
      // One report per angular sector guarantees coverage in every direction.
      const angle = burstAngle + (index + random() * 0.5) / values.length * Math.PI * 2;
      const distance = bossExpRewards.minDistance + random() *
        (bossExpRewards.maxDistance - bossExpRewards.minDistance);
      drop.scatter.dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
      drop.scatter.dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
    }
    reports.push(drop);
  }
  return reports;
}

/** Create one scattered report; explicit admin EXP overrides remain supported. */
function dropExpReport(enemy, random, value) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
  const drop = {
    id: ++nextId, kind: 'exp', value, tier: reportTier(value), x: enemy.x,
    y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
    rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
  };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop, random);
  return drop;
}

import { createBitmapText, glyphRectangle } from './bitmap-font.js';
import { getLootTotals } from './exp-drops.js';
import { getKillCount } from './world-state.js';

/** Reserve only visible caption ink, accounting for the slot art's top padding. */
export function levelCaptionSpacing(slotWidth, text) {
  const glyphs = [...text].filter(letter => letter !== ' ').map(glyphRectangle);
  const textWidth = [...text].reduce((sum, letter) => sum +
    (letter === ' ' ? 3 : glyphRectangle(letter).width - 1), 1);
  const inkBottom = Math.max(...glyphs.map(glyph => glyph.offsetY + glyph.height));
  const nextBoxInset = slotWidth * (1 - 237 / 255) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, slotWidth * 0.9 * inkBottom / textWidth - 6 - nextBoxInset);
}

/** Keep the equipment frame 2px below the lowest visible attack-level outline. */
function updateCaptionRowSpacing(container, entries) {
  let spacing = 0;
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry.caption.hidden) spacing = Math.max(spacing,
      levelCaptionSpacing(entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width, entry.captionText));
  }
  container.style.setProperty('--level-space', `${spacing}px`);
}

/** Arrange HUD values/portrait without introducing combat or experience mechanics. */
export function createHud(getFrameRectangle) {
  const exp = document.querySelector('#hud-exp');
  const expFill = document.querySelector('#hud-exp-fill');
  const expEdge = document.querySelector('#hud-exp-edge');
  const hp = document.querySelector('#hud-hp');
  const hpFill = document.querySelector('#hud-hp-fill');
  const hpNumbers = createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#hud-hp-numbers'), { scale: 1 });
  const portrait = document.querySelector('#hud-portrait');
  const level = createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#hud-level'));
  const creditsText = createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#hud-credits'), { scale: 1.25 });
  const killsText = createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#hud-kills'), { scale: 1.25 });
  const context = portrait.getContext('2d');
  let previousImage;
  let previousName;
  const profiles = new Map();
  let activeCharacter;

  /** Create six compact slots per row once, then update only changed artwork. */
  function createSlots(container, type) {
    const entries = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => {
      const slot = document.createElement('div');
      slot.className = 'hud-slot';
      slot.setAttribute('role', 'img');
      const base = document.createElement('img');
      base.alt = '';
      const icon = document.createElement('canvas');
      icon.width = icon.height = 128;
      icon.className = 'hud-slot-icon';
      icon.hidden = true;
      const caption = document.createElement('canvas');
      caption.className = 'hud-slot-level';
      caption.hidden = true;
      const levelText = createBitmapText(caption, { scale: 1, fitWidth: '90%' });
      slot.append(base, icon, caption);
      container.append(slot);
      return { slot, base, icon, caption, levelText, type, index, previous: null, container };
    });
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => updateCaptionRowSpacing(container, entries));
    observer.observe(container);
    return entries;
  }
  const attackSlots = createSlots(document.querySelector('#hud-attack-slots'), 'attack');
  const equipmentSlots = createSlots(document.querySelector('#hud-equipment-slots'), 'equipment');

  /** Occupied slots use a blank base so placeholder swords/clothes never show through. */
  function updateSlots(slots, items = []) {
    let changed = false;
    for (const entry of slots) {
      const item = items[entry.index];
      const source = item?.icon || '';
      const label = source ? item.name || `${entry.type} ${entry.index + 1}`
        : `Empty ${entry.type} slot ${entry.index + 1}`;
      const key = JSON.stringify([source, label, item?.iconCrop, item?.iconRotation, item?.level]);
      if (entry.previous === key) continue;
      changed = true;
      entry.previous = key;
      entry.base.src = `../sprites/hud/${source ? 'empty' : entry.type}-slot.png`;
      entry.icon.hidden = !source;
      entry.caption.hidden = !source || item?.level === undefined;
      if (!entry.caption.hidden) {
        entry.captionText = `LV ${item.level}`;
        entry.levelText.setText(entry.captionText);
      }
      const iconContext = entry.icon.getContext('2d');
      iconContext.clearRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
      if (source) {
        const image = new Image();
        // Render a single sheet pose without changing the original asset.
        image.onload = () => {
          if (entry.previous !== key) return;
          const crop = item.iconCrop || { x: 0, y: 0, width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight };
          const angle = (item.iconRotation || 0) * Math.PI / 180;
          const boundWidth = Math.abs(crop.width * Math.cos(angle)) + Math.abs(crop.height * Math.sin(angle));
          const boundHeight = Math.abs(crop.width * Math.sin(angle)) + Math.abs(crop.height * Math.cos(angle));
          const scale = 120 / Math.max(boundWidth, boundHeight);
          iconContext.save();
          iconContext.translate(64, 64);
          iconContext.rotate(angle);
          iconContext.drawImage(image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
            -crop.width * scale / 2, -crop.height * scale / 2, crop.width * scale, crop.height * scale);
          iconContext.restore();
        };
        image.src = source;
      }
      entry.slot.setAttribute('aria-label', item?.level === undefined ? label : `${label}, LV ${item.level}`);
      entry.slot.title = label;
    }
    if (changed) updateCaptionRowSpacing(slots[0].container, slots);
  }

  /** Assign or clear a future selected item: { name, icon: 'path/to/icon.png' }. */
  function setSlot(type, index, item) {
    if (!activeCharacter || !['attack', 'equipment'].includes(type) ||
        !Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index >= 6) return;
    const property = type === 'attack' ? 'attackSlots' : 'equipmentSlots';
    activeCharacter[property] ??= [];
    activeCharacter[property][index] = item || null;
    updateSlots(type === 'attack' ? attackSlots : equipmentSlots, activeCharacter[property]);
  }

  // Dedicated HUD profiles override sprite-sheet crops for these characters.
  for (const [label, file] of [['Plana', 'plana.png'], ['Arona', 'arona.png']]) {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => {
      profiles.set(label, image);
      previousName = undefined; // Refresh the active portrait on the next render.
    };
    // Keep the existing sprite portrait available if a profile cannot be loaded.
    image.src = `../sprites/hud/${file}`;
  }

  /** Reflect existing character state; defaults stay full HP and zero EXP for tests. */
  function update(character) {
    creditsText.setText(String(getLootTotals().credits));
    killsText.setText(String(getKillCount()));
    const playerLevel = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(character.level) || 1));
    level.setText(`LV: ${playerLevel}`);
    const maximumHp = Math.max(1, character.maxHp ?? 100);
    const health = Math.max(0, Math.min(maximumHp, character.hp ?? maximumHp));
    hpNumbers.setText(`${Math.ceil(health)}/${maximumHp}`);
    const maximumExp = Math.max(1, character.maxExp ?? 100);
    const experience = Math.max(0, Math.min(maximumExp, character.exp ?? 0));
    hp.setAttribute('aria-valuemax', String(maximumHp));
    hp.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(health));
    hp.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${health} / ${maximumHp} HP`);
    exp.setAttribute('aria-valuemax', String(maximumExp));
    exp.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(experience));
    exp.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${experience} / ${maximumExp} EXP`);
    // HP artwork is 643px wide; actual fill occupies source columns 72..628.
    // Map health to that interior so labels/end framing do not distort progress.
    const hpRightInset = health === 0 ? 100 : health === maximumHp ? 0
      : (643 - (72 + 557 * health / maximumHp)) / 643 * 100;
    hpFill.style.clipPath = `inset(0 ${hpRightInset}% 0 0)`;
    const percent = experience / maximumExp * 100;
    // Caps use their own filled artwork; only the middle is proportionally clipped.
    expFill.style.setProperty('--exp-unfilled', `${100 - percent}%`);
    expFill.dataset.hasExp = String(experience > 0);
    expFill.dataset.full = String(experience === maximumExp);
    // The middle starts after the 90px left cap and ends before the 15px right cap.
    expEdge.style.left = `calc(${percent}% + ${90 - 105 * percent / 100}px)`;
    expEdge.hidden = experience === 0;
    activeCharacter = character;
    updateSlots(attackSlots, character.attackSlots);
    updateSlots(equipmentSlots, character.equipmentSlots);
    if (previousImage === character.image && previousName === character.label) return;
    previousImage = character.image;
    previousName = character.label;
    portrait.setAttribute('aria-label', `${character.label} portrait`);
    context.clearRect(0, 0, portrait.width, portrait.height);
    const profile = profiles.get(character.label);
    if (profile) {
      // Preserve the entire profile and its proportions, with crisp pixel artwork.
      context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      const scale = Math.min(portrait.width / profile.naturalWidth, portrait.height / profile.naturalHeight);
      const width = profile.naturalWidth * scale;
      const height = profile.naturalHeight * scale;
      context.drawImage(profile, (portrait.width - width) / 2, (portrait.height - height) / 2, width, height);
      return;
    }
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    const image = character.animationFrames?.[0].image || character.image;
    const pose = { ...character, direction: character.defaultDirection || 'down', moving: false, attack: null };
    const crop = character.animationFrames
      ? { x: 0, y: 0, width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight }
      : getFrameRectangle(pose, 0);
    // Focus on the upper body/face; use the source sheet without editing the asset.
    const side = Math.min(crop.width, crop.height * 0.65);
    context.drawImage(image, crop.x + (crop.width - side) / 2, crop.y,
      side, side, 0, 0, portrait.width, portrait.height);
  }
  return { update, setSlot };
}

import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
export function glyphRectangle(character) {
  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
}

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3, fitWidth = null } = {}) {
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const characters = [...text];
    const advances = characters.map(character => character === ' '
      ? spaceWidth : glyphRectangle(character).width - outlineOverlap);
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, (advances.reduce((sum, width) => sum + width, 0) + outlineOverlap) * scale);
    canvas.height = 20 * scale;
    // Optional responsive captions keep their aspect ratio inside a slot.
    canvas.style.width = fitWidth || `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = fitWidth ? 'auto' : `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    let x = 0;
    for (const [index, character] of characters.entries()) {
      if (character !== ' ') {
        const glyph = glyphRectangle(character);
        context.drawImage(image, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
          x * scale, glyph.offsetY * scale, glyph.width * scale, glyph.height * scale);
      }
      x += advances[index];
    }
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = '../sprites/font.png';
  return {
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();
    }
  };
}

      if (action === 'damage' && !damagePlayer(character, amount)) {
        feedback.textContent = 'HP is already zero.';
      }
      if (action === 'heal') healPlayer(character, amount);
      if (action === 'full-heal') healPlayer(character, character.maxHp);
      if (action === 'preview-crit') showDamageNumber(character, 23, false, 'critical');
      if (action === 'preview-supercrit') showDamageNumber(character, 23, false, 'supercritical');
      if (action === 'reset') {
        Object.assign(character, { level: 1, exp: 0, hp: character.maxHp, invincible: true });
        character.combatStats = { ...defaultCombatStats };
        delete character.damageFlashElapsed;
        ensurePlayerStats(character);
      }
      update();
      onChange(character);
    });
  });
  update();
  return { update };
}
44:    damagePlayer(player, baseDamage * (npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1));

import { isBossEnemy } from './world-state.js';

export const playtestSpawnSettings = {
  perSecond: 5, crowdedPerSecond: 1, visibleLimit: 50,
  offscreenMargin: 100, placementAttempts: 30, bossOppositeChance: 0.85
};

/** Count enemies whose sprite area intersects the actual gameplay viewport. */
export function visibleEnemyCount(enemies, camera, width, height) {
  return enemies.filter(enemy => {
    const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || 112) / 2;
    return enemy.x + radius >= camera.x && enemy.x - radius <= camera.x + width &&
      enemy.y + radius >= camera.y && enemy.y - radius <= camera.y + height;
  }).length;
}

/** Rank legal entrances by enemy count relative to the player; randomize ties. */
export function leastCrowdedSides(stage, enemies, player, random = Math.random) {
  const sides = stage.axis === 'horizontal' ? ['left', 'right']
    : stage.axis === 'vertical' ? ['top', 'bottom'] : ['left', 'right', 'top', 'bottom'];
  const counts = Object.fromEntries(sides.map(side => [side, 0]));
  for (const enemy of enemies) {
    const dx = enemy.x - player.x, dy = enemy.y - player.y;
    if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) continue;
    const side = stage.axis === 'horizontal' ? (dx < 0 ? 'left' : 'right')
      : stage.axis === 'vertical' ? (dy < 0 ? 'top' : 'bottom')
      : Math.abs(dx) >= Math.abs(dy) ? (dx < 0 ? 'left' : 'right') : (dy < 0 ? 'top' : 'bottom');
    counts[side]++;
  }
  return sides.map(side => ({ side, count: counts[side], tie: random() }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.count - b.count || a.tie - b.tie).map(entry => entry.side);
}

/** Pressure the escape route opposite the nearest boss, within legal map entrances. */
export function oppositeBossSide(stage, enemies, player, random = Math.random) {
  const boss = enemies.filter(isBossEnemy).sort((a,b) =>
    Math.hypot(a.x-player.x,a.y-player.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-player.x,b.y-player.y))[0];
  if (!boss) return undefined;
  const dx = player.x - boss.x, dy = player.y - boss.y;
  if (!dx && !dy) return undefined;
  const directions = stage.axis === 'horizontal' ? [['left',-1,0],['right',1,0]]
    : stage.axis === 'vertical' ? [['top',0,-1],['bottom',0,1]]
    : [['left',-1,0],['right',1,0],['top',0,-1],['bottom',0,1]];
  return directions.map(([side,x,y]) => ({ side, score: dx*x+dy*y, tie: random() }))
    .sort((a,b) => b.score-a.score || a.tie-b.tie)[0].side;
}

/** Choose an offscreen entrance compatible with the current map's playable axis. */
export function offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, width, height, random = Math.random, preferredSide) {
  const margin = stage.spawnMargin ?? playtestSpawnSettings.offscreenMargin;
  const between = (low, high) => low <= high ? low + random() * (high - low) : null;
  if (stage.axis === 'horizontal') {
    const y = between(Math.max(camera.y, stage.playableBounds?.top ?? camera.y + (stage.topPadding || 0)) + margin,
      Math.min(camera.y + height, stage.playableBounds?.bottom ?? camera.y + height - (stage.bottomPadding || 0)) - margin);
    const left = preferredSide ? preferredSide === 'left' : random() < 0.5;
    return y === null ? null : { x: left ? camera.x - margin : camera.x + width + margin, y };
  }
  if (stage.axis === 'vertical') {
    const x = between(Math.max(camera.x, stage.playableBounds?.left ?? camera.x + width * (stage.leftWallRatio || 0)) + margin,
      Math.min(camera.x + width, stage.playableBounds?.right ?? camera.x + width * (stage.rightWallRatio ?? 1)) - margin);
    const top = preferredSide ? preferredSide === 'top' : random() < 0.5;
    return x === null ? null : { x, y: top ? camera.y - margin : camera.y + height + margin };
  }
  const side = preferredSide || ['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right'][Math.floor(random() * 4)];
  if (side === 'top' || side === 'bottom') return { x: camera.x + random() * width,
    y: side === 'top' ? camera.y - margin : camera.y + height + margin };
  return { x: side === 'left' ? camera.x - margin : camera.x + width + margin,
    y: camera.y + random() * height };
}

/** Run capped one-second spawn batches; stopping affects new spawns only. */
export function createPlaytestSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage, spawnEnemy, slotsRemaining, onBatch, getEnemies, getPlayer }) {
  const button = document.querySelector('#toggle-random-spawning');
  const status = document.querySelector('#random-spawn-status');
  let running = true;
  let elapsed = 0;
  let lastStatus = '';

  /** Slow new arrivals when the visible crowd reaches the testing threshold. */
  function crowdState() {
    const visible = visibleEnemyCount(getEnemies(), camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return { visible, rate: visible >= playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit
      ? playtestSpawnSettings.crowdedPerSecond : playtestSpawnSettings.perSecond };
  }

  /** Keep the sidebar button explicit about the next available action. */
  function updateControls(message = '') {
    button.textContent = running ? 'Stop random spawning' : 'Start random spawning';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(running));
    const crowd = crowdState();
    status.textContent = `${running ? 'Spawning' : 'Stopped'}: ${crowd.rate}/s\nOn screen: ${crowd.visible}/${playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit}\n${message || 'Offscreen chase spawns'}`;
    lastStatus = `${running}:${crowd.rate}:${crowd.visible}`;
  }
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    running = !running;
    elapsed = 0;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Validate offscreen attempts using the same map collisions as manual NPC spawns. */
  function update(delta) {
    const crowd = crowdState();
    if (lastStatus !== `${running}:${crowd.rate}:${crowd.visible}`) updateControls();
    if (!running) return;
    elapsed += delta;
    if (elapsed < 1) return;
    elapsed %= 1;
    let spawned = 0;
    const stage = getStage();
    for (let i = 0; i < crowd.rate && slotsRemaining() > 0; i++) {
      const enemies = getEnemies(), player = getPlayer();
      const bossSide = Math.random() < playtestSpawnSettings.bossOppositeChance
        ? oppositeBossSide(stage, enemies, player) : undefined;
      const ranked = bossSide || crowd.visible >= playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit
        ? leastCrowdedSides(stage, enemies, player) : [];
      const sides = bossSide ? [bossSide, ...ranked.filter(side => side !== bossSide)] : ranked;
      const attemptsPerSide = sides.length ? Math.ceil(playtestSpawnSettings.placementAttempts / sides.length) : 0;
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < playtestSpawnSettings.placementAttempts; attempt++) {
        // Try the least-populated side first; blocked ground falls back to others.
        const side = sides.length
          ? sides[Math.min(sides.length - 1, Math.floor(attempt / attemptsPerSide))] : undefined;
        const point = offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, Math.random, side);
        if (!point) continue;
        if (spawnEnemy(point.x, point.y)) { spawned++; break; }
      }
    }
    onBatch();
    updateControls(`Last batch: ${spawned}.${slotsRemaining() === 0 ? ' At cap.' : ''}`);
  }
  updateControls();
  return { update };
}

import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03 },
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.38, y: 0.04 },
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.43, y: 0 }
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + size * profile.y,
    rx: size * profile.rx, ry: size * profile.ry };
}

/** Test a blade segment against an ellipse in normalized body coordinates. */
export function segmentHitsBody(body, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  const x = (x1 - body.x) / body.rx, y = (y1 - body.y) / body.ry;
  const dx = (x2 - x1) / body.rx, dy = (y2 - y1) / body.ry;
  const length = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  const t = length ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -(x * dx + y * dy) / length)) : 0;
  return (x + dx * t) ** 2 + (y + dy * t) ** 2 <= 1;
}

# Project integration sizing contract

Do not migrate gameplay into project.html until the user approves it.

## Characters

Use scene-metrics.js in both the development preview and the eventual project renderer:

- Normal player/NPC sprite area: 112 CSS/world pixels.
- Boss sprite area: 224 CSS/world pixels.
- Shared sprite display padding: 7 pixels.

These values approximate the apparent size of the former 130/260-pixel actors after the old 1280-pixel canvas was displayed at roughly 1108 pixels wide. Actual visible artwork size still depends on each sheet's referenceSize and transparent padding. Preserve those per-sheet settings and source crops. Do not multiply character size by browser width, fullscreen size, or map zoom.

viewport.js sets canvas dimensions to its displayed CSS dimensions. This makes one world unit equal one displayed pixel; larger views reveal more world. Reuse it in the project screen. Keep the CSS canvas dimensions explicitly controlled by the viewport/container. If high-DPI rendering is added later, apply devicePixelRatio to the backing buffer/context only; keep world and collision coordinates in CSS pixels.

## Maps

- Playarea 1: scale background to viewport height; horizontal scroll only.
- Playarea 2: scale background to viewport width; vertical scroll only.
- Playarea 3: retain fixed world tile dimensions, overlap, seed, and source collision scale. Larger viewports display more tiles without enlarging them.
- Playarea 4: retain islandScale and finite image world dimensions. Larger viewports reveal more of the island; do not automatically fit/stretch the island to fullscreen.

// EDIT map zoom independently of actor sizes. All stages use this multiplier.
export const mapSizeMultiplier = 1.5;

/** Physical playable limits for the enlarged horizontal/vertical strip maps. */
export function stripMapBounds(map, width, height, topPadding = 0, bottomPadding = 0) {
  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') return {
    left: -Infinity, right: Infinity,
    top: map.originY + topPadding,
    bottom: map.originY + height * mapSizeMultiplier - bottomPadding
  };
  if (map.axis !== 'vertical') return { left: -Infinity, right: Infinity, top: -Infinity, bottom: Infinity };
  return {
    left: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.leftWallRatio || 0),
    right: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.rightWallRatio ?? 1),
    top: -Infinity, bottom: Infinity
  };
}

/** Stop the camera at finite edges while leaving the long map axis infinite. */
export function clampStripCamera(map, camera, width, height) {
  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') camera.y = Math.max(map.originY,
    Math.min(map.originY + height * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.y));
  if (map.axis === 'vertical') camera.x = Math.max(map.originX,
    Math.min(map.originX + width * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.x));
}

/** Keep enlarged enemy spawns inside physical walls, independent of the camera. */
export function canSpawnInStrip(character, x, y, bounds, defaultSize = 112) {
  const margin = (character.spriteSize || defaultSize) / 2;
  return x >= bounds.left + margin && x <= bounds.right - margin &&
    y >= bounds.top + margin && y <= bounds.bottom - margin;
}
  const facing = activeCharacter.horizontalFacingOnly ? activeCharacter.facing : activeCharacter.direction;

  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

export function createPlaytestSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage, spawnEnemy, slotsRemaining, onBatch, getEnemies, getPlayer }) {
  const button = document.querySelector('#toggle-random-spawning');
  const status = document.querySelector('#random-spawn-status');
  let running = true;
  let elapsed = 0;
  let lastStatus = '';

  /** Slow new arrivals when the visible crowd reaches the testing threshold. */
  function crowdState() {
    const enemies = getEnemies();
    const visible = visibleEnemyCount(enemies, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return { visible, rate: adaptiveSpawnRate(enemies, getPlayer(), visible) };
  }

  /** Keep the sidebar button explicit about the next available action. */
  function updateControls(message = '') {
    button.textContent = running ? 'Stop random spawning' : 'Start random spawning';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(running));
    const crowd = crowdState();
    status.textContent = `${running ? 'Spawning' : 'Stopped'}: ${crowd.rate}/s\nOn screen: ${crowd.visible}/${playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit}\n${message || 'Offscreen chase spawns'}`;
    lastStatus = `${running}:${crowd.rate}:${crowd.visible}`;
  }
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    running = !running;
    elapsed = 0;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Validate offscreen attempts using the same map collisions as manual NPC spawns. */
  function update(delta) {
    const crowd = crowdState();
    if (lastStatus !== `${running}:${crowd.rate}:${crowd.visible}`) updateControls();
    if (!running) return;
    elapsed += delta;
    if (elapsed < 1) return;
    elapsed %= 1;
    let spawned = 0;
    const stage = getStage();
    for (let i = 0; i < crowd.rate && slotsRemaining() > 0; i++) {
      const enemies = getEnemies(), player = getPlayer();
      // Bonus arrivals fill gaps even while the baseline wave pressures a boss escape route.
      const bonusSpawn = i >= playtestSpawnSettings.perSecond;
      const bossSide = !bonusSpawn && Math.random() < playtestSpawnSettings.bossOppositeChance
        ? oppositeBossSide(stage, enemies, player) : undefined;
      const ranked = bonusSpawn || bossSide || crowd.visible >= playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit
        ? leastCrowdedSides(stage, enemies, player) : [];
      const sides = bossSide ? [bossSide, ...ranked.filter(side => side !== bossSide)] : ranked;
      const attemptsPerSide = sides.length ? Math.ceil(playtestSpawnSettings.placementAttempts / sides.length) : 0;
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < playtestSpawnSettings.placementAttempts; attempt++) {
        // Try the least-populated side first; blocked ground falls back to others.
        const side = sides.length
          ? sides[Math.min(sides.length - 1, Math.floor(attempt / attemptsPerSide))] : undefined;
        const point = offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, Math.random, side);
        if (!point) continue;
        if (spawnEnemy(point.x, point.y)) { spawned++; break; }
      }
    }
    onBatch();
    updateControls(`Last batch: ${spawned}.${slotsRemaining() === 0 ? ' At cap.' : ''}`);
  }
  updateControls();
  return { update };
}

VERBATIM AGGREGATED_OUTPUT:
export function createPlaytestSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage, spawnEnemy, slotsRemaining, onBatch, getEnemies, getPlayer }) {
  const button = document.querySelector('#toggle-random-spawning');
  const status = document.querySelector('#random-spawn-status');
  let running = true;
  let elapsed = 0;
  let lastStatus = '';
  let distributionStage;
  let baselineCounts = {}; // Successful base-wave arrivals per entrance, across batches.

  /** Slow new arrivals when the visible crowd reaches the testing threshold. */
  function crowdState() {
    const enemies = getEnemies();
    const visible = visibleEnemyCount(enemies, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return { visible, rate: adaptiveSpawnRate(enemies, getPlayer(), visible) };
  }

  /** Keep the sidebar button explicit about the next available action. */
  function updateControls(message = '') {
    button.textContent = running ? 'Stop random spawning' : 'Start random spawning';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(running));
    const crowd = crowdState();
    status.textContent = `${running ? 'Spawning' : 'Stopped'}: ${crowd.rate}/s\nOn screen: ${crowd.visible}/${playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit}\n${message || 'Offscreen chase spawns'}`;
    lastStatus = `${running}:${crowd.rate}:${crowd.visible}`;
  }
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    running = !running;
    elapsed = 0;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Validate offscreen attempts using the same map collisions as manual NPC spawns. */
  function update(delta) {
    const crowd = crowdState();
    if (lastStatus !== `${running}:${crowd.rate}:${crowd.visible}`) updateControls();
    if (!running) return;
    elapsed += delta;
    if (elapsed < 1) return;
    elapsed %= 1;
    let spawned = 0;
    const stage = getStage();
    const stageKey = stage.id || stage.axis;
    if (distributionStage !== stageKey) {
      distributionStage = stageKey;
      baselineCounts = {};
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < crowd.rate && slotsRemaining() > 0; i++) {
      const enemies = getEnemies(), player = getPlayer();
      const bonusSpawn = i >= playtestSpawnSettings.perSecond;
      const legalSides = offscreenSpawnSides(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const rankedStage = { ...stage, availableSides: legalSides };
      // Balance successful base arrivals across batches; random ties rotate the extra fifth spawn.
      // Bonus arrivals instead fill the lowest current enemy density.
      const sides = bonusSpawn || crowd.visible >= playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit
        ? leastCrowdedSides(rankedStage, enemies, player)
        : legalSides.map(side => ({ side, count: baselineCounts[side] || 0, tie: Math.random() }))
          .sort((a, b) => a.count - b.count || a.tie - b.tie).map(entry => entry.side);
      const attemptsPerSide = sides.length ? Math.ceil(playtestSpawnSettings.placementAttempts / sides.length) : 0;
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < playtestSpawnSettings.placementAttempts; attempt++) {
        // Try the least-populated side first; blocked ground falls back to others.
        const side = sides.length
          ? sides[Math.min(sides.length - 1, Math.floor(attempt / attemptsPerSide))] : undefined;
        const point = offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, Math.random, side);
        if (!point) continue;
        if (spawnEnemy(point.x, point.y)) {
          spawned++;
          if (!bonusSpawn && side) baselineCounts[side] = (baselineCounts[side] || 0) + 1;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    onBatch();
    updateControls(`Last batch: ${spawned}.${slotsRemaining() === 0 ? ' At cap.' : ''}`);
  }
  updateControls();
  return { update };
}

import { dropEnemyExp, dropEnemyLoot } from './exp-drops.js';
import { beginEnemyDeath } from './enemy-death.js';
import { showDamageNumber } from './damage-numbers.js';
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

export const enemyPopulationSettings = { limit: 400, despawnDistance: 100, trimAt: 0.9, trimTo: 0.7 };

/** Boss identity is explicit, never inferred from an elite's enlarged sprite. */
export function isBossEnemy(enemy) {
  return enemy.boss === true || enemy.type === 'iroha' || enemy.type === 'shiroko';
}

/** Measure distance from sprite edges to the gameplay viewport rectangle. */
export function enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height) {
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2;
  const dx = Math.max(camera.x - (enemy.x + radius), enemy.x - radius - camera.x - width, 0);
  const dy = Math.max(camera.y - (enemy.y + radius), enemy.y - radius - camera.y - height, 0);
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}

const enemies = new Map();
const spawnListeners = new Set();
const defeatListeners = new Set();
let killCount = 0;

/** Observe real spawns/defeats; cleanup removals never emit these events. */
export function onEnemySpawn(listener) {
  spawnListeners.add(listener);
  return () => spawnListeners.delete(listener);
}
export function onEnemyDefeat(listener) {
  defeatListeners.add(listener);
  return () => defeatListeners.delete(listener);
}

/** Count confirmed defeats for this session; admin removal does not count. */
export function getKillCount() {
  return killCount;
}

/** Return all session records, including enemies outside the camera view. */
export function getAllEnemies() {
  return [...enemies.values()];
}

/** Explicitly clear the test population without affecting player state. */
export function clearEnemies() {
  enemies.clear();
}

/** Add or update an enemy's state without tying its lifetime to camera visibility. */
export function rememberEnemy(id, state) {
  const existed = enemies.has(id);
  const enemy = { ...enemies.get(id), ...state, id };
  enemies.set(id, enemy);
  if (!existed) for (const listener of spawnListeners) listener(enemy);
  return enemy;
}

/** Read a remembered enemy even after its background tile has left the screen. */
export function getEnemy(id) {
  return enemies.get(id);
}

/** Mix local start time with random entropy so each new run gets a fresh seed. */
export function createRunSeed(time = new Date(), entropy) {
  if (entropy === undefined) {
    entropy = globalThis.crypto?.getRandomValues
      ? globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0]
      : Math.floor(Math.random() * 4294967296);
  }
  const localTime = [time.getFullYear(), time.getMonth(), time.getDate(),
    time.getHours(), time.getMinutes(), time.getSeconds(), time.getMilliseconds(),
    time.getTimezoneOffset(), entropy].join(':');
  let hash = 2166136261;
  for (const character of localTime) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ character.charCodeAt(0), 16777619);
  return (hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0;
}

// Generated once per page/game start; map changes and scene resets reuse it.
export const runStartedAt = new Date();
/** Seed 0 is an explicit admin preview; ordinary starts still use local time. */
export function selectRunSeed(search = '', time = runStartedAt, entropy) {
  return new URLSearchParams(search).get('seed') === '0' ? 0 : createRunSeed(time, entropy);
}
export const runSeed = selectRunSeed(globalThis.location?.search || '');

const directions = ['down', 'downLeft', 'left', 'upLeft', 'up', 'upRight', 'right', 'downRight'];

/** Build a configurable-column/eight-row grid within editable source-image margins. */
export function makeGrid(width, height, margins, columns = 5) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(columns) || columns < 1 || columns > 64) {
    throw new Error('Columns must be an integer from 1 to 64.');
  }
  const { left, top, right, bottom } = margins;
  if (Object.values(margins).some(value => !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) ||
      left + right >= width || top + bottom >= height) {
    throw new Error('Margins must leave a non-empty sprite area.');
  }
  const columnEdges = Array.from({ length: columns + 1 }, (_, i) => left + (width - left - right) * i / columns);
  const edges = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => top + (height - top - bottom) * i / 8);
  return { columnEdges, rowEdges: Array.from({ length: columns }, () => [...edges]) };
}

/** Decode a local image before replacing the currently working sprite. */
function loadImage(url) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => resolve(image);
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Cannot read this image. Choose a PNG, WebP, or JPEG sprite sheet.'));
    image.src = url;
  });
}

/** Install session-only sprite swapping; built-in assets and crop settings stay intact. */
export function setupSpriteTester(characters, switchCharacter) {
  const form = document.querySelector('#sprite-tester');
  const target = form.elements.namedItem('target');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#sprite-feedback');
  const originals = new Map(Object.entries(characters).map(([name, character]) =>
    [name, { ...character }]
  ));
  const localUrls = new Map();

  /** Populate editable row/mirror controls from the chosen avatar's current setup. */
  function showSettings() {
    const character = characters[target.value];
    form.elements.namedItem('rows').value = directions.map(direction => character.rows[direction]).join(',');
    form.elements.namedItem('mirrors').value = (character.mirroredDirections || []).join(',');
    form.elements.namedItem('reference').value = character.referenceSize || 215;
    form.elements.namedItem('columns').value = character.layout.columnEdges.length - 1;
  }

  target.addEventListener('change', showSettings);
  showSettings();

  // Decode first, then atomically apply; failed uploads leave the old sheet usable.
  form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const name = target.value;
    const apply = form.querySelector('[type="submit"]');
    let url;
    apply.disabled = true;
    feedback.textContent = 'Loading sprite settingsâ€¦';
    try {
      const rows = form.elements.namedItem('rows').value.split(',').map(value => Number(value.trim()));
      if (rows.length !== 8 || rows.some(row => !Number.isInteger(row) || row < 0 || row > 7)) {
        throw new Error('Enter eight row indices between 0 and 7.');
      }
      const mirrors = form.elements.namedItem('mirrors').value.split(',').map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      if (mirrors.some(direction => !directions.includes(direction))) throw new Error('Unknown mirrored direction.');
      const file = form.elements.namedItem('sheet').files[0];
      if (file) url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      const image = url ? await loadImage(url) : characters[name].image;
      const margins = Object.fromEntries(['left', 'top', 'right', 'bottom'].map(edge =>
        [edge, Number(form.elements.namedItem(edge).value)]
      ));
      const layout = form.elements.namedItem('layout').value === 'grid'
        ? makeGrid(image.naturalWidth, image.naturalHeight, margins, Number(form.elements.namedItem('columns').value))
        : originals.get(name).layout;
      if (layout.columnEdges.at(-1) > image.naturalWidth ||
          layout.rowEdges.some(edges => edges.at(-1) > image.naturalHeight)) {
        throw new Error('Built-in crops exceed this image. Choose the regular grid layout.');
      }
      const referenceSize = Number(form.elements.namedItem('reference').value);
      if (!Number.isFinite(referenceSize) || referenceSize <= 0) throw new Error('Display reference size must be positive.');
      Object.assign(characters[name], {
        image, layout, rows: Object.fromEntries(directions.map((direction, i) => [direction, rows[i]])),
        mirroredDirections: mirrors, idleRows: {}, referenceSize,
        walkFrames: Object.fromEntries(directions.map(direction => [direction, Array.from({ length: layout.columnEdges.length - 1 }, (_, i) => i)])),
        elapsed: 0, moving: false
      });
      if (url) {
        if (localUrls.has(name)) URL.revokeObjectURL(localUrls.get(name));
        localUrls.set(name, url);
        url = undefined;
      }
      switchCharacter(name);
      feedback.textContent = `${characters[name].label}: test sheet applied (${image.naturalWidth} Ã— ${image.naturalHeight}).`;
    } catch (error) {
      feedback.textContent = error.message;
    } finally {
      if (url) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      apply.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  /** Restore the selected avatar's built-in sheet without moving the player. */
  document.querySelector('#restore-sprite').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const name = target.value;
    const { x, y, direction } = characters[name];
    Object.assign(characters[name], originals.get(name), { x, y, direction, moving: false, elapsed: 0 });
    if (localUrls.has(name)) URL.revokeObjectURL(localUrls.get(name));
    localUrls.delete(name);
    form.elements.namedItem('sheet').value = '';
    showSettings();
// Per-column row boundaries in SOURCE IMAGE pixels, measured from the sheet top.
// The imported rows are uneven: equal-height slicing cuts hair, feet, and halos.
// Each column has nine edges defining eight rows. Adjust an edge up/down to
// move the shared boundary between two rows; keep values in increasing order.
// Change columnEdges if horizontal frame cropping needs adjustment.
// Arona has a large left margin and narrower columns; its layout is independent.
// Optional footY values anchor visible feet instead of transparent crop bottoms.
// Optional frames[row][column] overrides handle attack effects outside grid cells.
// anchorX is a SOURCE IMAGE coordinate: keep it on the tank, not the flash/flag.
// Packed right-cannon frames must stay inside their column to prevent neighbor bleed.
// Right-firing crops are shifted +18 source pixels; anchorX stays fixed.

// CSS-pixel sizes, NOT fractions of viewport width or height. Do not scale them
// up on migration to the project screen or when entering fullscreen.
// Original preview: 130 * (1108 / 1280) â‰ˆ 112 normal, twice that for bosses.
export const normalSpriteSize = 89.6;
export const bossSpriteSize = 179.2;
export const spriteDisplayPadding = 5.6;
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

export const eliteChance = 0.01;
export const mobBaseHp = 60;
export const shirokoBossStats = { hpMultiplier: 100, contactDamage: 10 };

/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random) {
  const elite = type === 'mob' && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteChance));
  const baseHp = type === 'mob' ? mobBaseHp
    : type === 'shiroko' ? mobBaseHp * shirokoBossStats.hpMultiplier : 100;
  const maxHp = baseHp * (elite ? 10 : 1);
  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite ? 1.5 : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : undefined,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1
  };
}

export const pickupMagnet = { acceleration: 1200, maxSpeed: 650 }; // Pixels/secÂ² and pixels/sec.
export const creditDropChance = 1 / 90; // EDIT occasional credit chance (~1.11%).
export const secretNoteDropChance = 0.001; // 0.1% per defeated enemy.
// EDIT elite bonus rewards independently of normal-enemy drop rates.
export const eliteLoot = { creditChance: 0.2, creditAmount: 5, noteChance: 0.01 };
const lootTotals = { credits: 0, secretTechNotes: 0 }; // Shared across avatar swaps.
export const dropScatter = { duration: 0.28, minDistance: 40, maxDistance: 80, hopHeight: 18 };

/** Launch loot toward a random nearby landing spot with a small airborne hop. */
export function launchDrop(drop, random = Math.random) {
  const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const distance = dropScatter.minDistance + random() * (dropScatter.maxDistance - dropScatter.minDistance);
  drop.scatter = { elapsed: 0, x: drop.x, y: drop.y,
    dx: Math.cos(angle) * distance, dy: Math.sin(angle) * distance,
    rotation: drop.rotation, spin: (random() - 0.5) * Math.PI };
  return drop;
}

/** Animate the outward toss before enabling pickup attraction or collection. */
export function updateDropScatter(drop, delta) {
  if (!drop.scatter) return false;
  const flight = drop.scatter;
  flight.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const t = Math.min(1, flight.elapsed / dropScatter.duration);
  const progress = 1 - (1 - t) ** 2;
  drop.x = flight.x + flight.dx * progress;
  drop.y = flight.y + flight.dy * progress;
  drop.lift = 4 * dropScatter.hopHeight * t * (1 - t);
  drop.rotation = flight.rotation + flight.spin * progress;
  if (t === 1) { delete drop.scatter; drop.lift = 0; }
  return true;
}

/** Read session inventory; spending and attack upgrades will be implemented later. */
export function getLootTotals() {
  return { ...lootTotals };
}

/** Test source-space points against an angled polygon. */
export function pointInPolygon(x,y,polygon) {
  let inside=false;
  for(let i=0,j=polygon.length-1;i<polygon.length;j=i++) {
    const [xi,yi]=polygon[i], [xj,yj]=polygon[j];
    if((yi>y)!==(yj>y) && x<(xj-xi)*(y-yi)/(yj-yi)+xi) inside=!inside;
  }
  return inside;
}

/** Reject any obstacle intersecting the actor's source-space foot rectangle. */
function intersectsBox(polygon,left,top,right,bottom) {
  if([[left,top],[right,top],[right,bottom],[left,bottom]].some(([x,y])=>pointInPolygon(x,y,polygon)))return true;
  if(polygon.some(([x,y])=>x>=left&&x<=right&&y>=top&&y<=bottom))return true;
  for(let i=0;i<polygon.length;i++) {
    const [x,y]=polygon[i], [xx,yy]=polygon[(i+1)%polygon.length];
    // Parametric clipping of each polygon edge against the rectangle.
    let enter=0,exit=1;
    for(const [p,q]of [[-(xx-x),x-left],[xx-x,right-x],[-(yy-y),y-top],[yy-y,bottom-y]]) {
      if(p===0){if(q<0){enter=2;break;}}else if(p<0)enter=Math.max(enter,q/p);else exit=Math.min(exit,q/p);
    }
    if(enter<=exit)return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Keep foot corners safely inside the paving, away from the sea-facing wall. */
function insideShore(x, y) {
  if (!pointInPolygon(x, y, islandBoundary)) return false;
  for (let i = 0; i < islandBoundary.length; i++) {
    const [ax, ay] = islandBoundary[i];
    const [bx, by] = islandBoundary[(i + 1) % islandBoundary.length];
    const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay;
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((x - ax) * dx + (y - ay) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy)));
    if (Math.hypot(x - ax - t * dx, y - ay - t * dy) < shoreClearance) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.
export const defaultCombatStats = { atkPercent: 0, spdPercent: 0, critPercent: 0, pickupPercent: 0, hastePercent: 0 };

/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  return 1 + Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0) / 100;
}

/** Roll critical hits per enemy hit; critical damage is twice normal damage. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, baseDamage, random = Math.random) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const critical = random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent)) / 100;
  return { damage: Math.max(1, Math.round(baseDamage * statMultiplier(character, 'atkPercent') * (critical ? 2 : 1))),
    critical, type: critical ? 'critical' : 'normal' };
}
import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { statMultiplier, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';

// EDIT attack balance and timing here. Interval is measured start to start:
// 1 second total = 0.2 seconds swinging + 0.8 seconds before the next swing.
export const umbrellaSettings = {
  interval: 1, duration: 0.2, damage: 23, arcDegrees: 190,
  baseRadius: 64, // EDIT where the handle's orbit begins, outside Plana's sprite.
  reach: 176, // Outer tip radius; blade length is reach minus baseRadius.
  trailDuration: 0.13, trailAngleStep: 0.012, maxAfterimages: 192,
  trailBlur: 3, trailLinger: 0.18 // Blur in pixels; fade time after the attack ends.
};
const crop = { x: 100, y: 228, width: 68, height: 304 };

/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180Â° sweep. */
export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed, duration = umbrellaSettings.duration) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / duration));
  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
  const arc = umbrellaSettings.arcDegrees * Math.PI / 180;
  return aim - arc / 2 + eased * arc;
}

/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle) {
  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy);
  const dx = body.x - player.x, dy = body.y - player.y;
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const radius = Math.max(body.rx, body.ry);
  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach + radius) return false;
  if (distance + radius < umbrellaSettings.baseRadius) return false;
  // Subdivide the swept sector into blade segments at most 2 degrees apart.
  const samples = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.abs(toAngle - fromAngle) / (Math.PI / 90)));
  for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
    const angle = fromAngle + (toAngle - fromAngle) * i / samples;
    const x = Math.cos(angle), y = Math.sin(angle);
    if (segmentHitsBody(body,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.reach, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.reach)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Load the umbrella and own its repeating attack, hit tracking, and motion trail. */
export function createUmbrellaAttack() {
  const image = new Image();
  image.src = '../sprites/attacks/plana umbrella.png';

/** Load a sheet before animation begins and report an actionable loading error. */
function loadSheet(character) {
  if (character.gifFrames) return loadGifAnimation(character);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => {
      character.image = image;
      resolve();
    };
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${character.source}.`));
    image.src = character.source;
  });
}

/** Resolve keyboard input to one of the four supported movement directions. */
function directionForKey(key) {
  return {
    ArrowUp: 'up', w: 'up', ArrowDown: 'down', s: 'down',
    ArrowLeft: 'left', a: 'left', ArrowRight: 'right', d: 'right'
  }[key.length === 1 ? key.toLowerCase() : key];
}

/** Clear held input when focus is lost so characters cannot get stuck moving. */
function releaseControls() {
  heldDirections.clear();
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
  if (pauseMenu?.paused) return;
  // Let admin form fields use their own arrow keys and text input.
  if (event.target?.closest('input, select, textarea')) return;
  const direction = directionForKey(event.key);
  if (!direction) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  if (!event.repeat) heldDirections.set(event.code, direction);
});

window.addEventListener('keyup', event => {
  return enemy;
}

/** Read a remembered enemy even after its background tile has left the screen. */
export function getEnemy(id) {
  return enemies.get(id);
}

/** Apply damage and trigger a brief sprite pulse; remove defeated test enemies. */
export function damageEnemy(id, amount, source, hitType = 'normal') {
  const enemy = enemies.get(id);
  if (!enemy || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - amount);
  showDamageNumber(enemy, amount, false, hitType); // Include overkill and crit styling.
  enemy.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
  if (enemy.hp === 0) {
    const bossesAliveBefore = [...enemies.values()].filter(isBossEnemy).length;
    killCount++;
    dropEnemyExp(enemy);
    dropEnemyLoot(enemy);
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source);
    enemies.delete(id);
    for (const listener of defeatListeners) listener({ enemy, bossesAliveBefore });
  }
  return enemy;
}

/** Return enemies near the viewport for future rendering; retain all other records. */
export function getVisibleEnemies(cameraX, viewportWidth, margin = 160) {
  return [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy =>
    enemy.x >= cameraX - margin &&
    enemy.x <= cameraX + viewportWidth + margin
  );
}

/** Remove an enemy deliberately, for example after a confirmed defeat. */
export function removeEnemy(id) {
  enemies.delete(id);
}

/** Load predecoded GIF display frames while retaining original frame durations. */
export async function loadGifAnimation(character) {
  character.animationFrames = await Promise.all(character.gifFrames.map(frame =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const image = new Image();
      image.onload = () => resolve({ image, duration: frame.duration });
      image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${frame.source}.`));
      image.src = frame.source;
    })
  ));
  character.image = character.animationFrames[0].image;
}

/** Select the original GIF frame for elapsed playback time, including while idle. */
export function gifFrameAt(frames, elapsed) {
  const total = frames.reduce((sum, frame) => sum + frame.duration, 0);
  let time = elapsed % total;
  for (let i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
    time -= frames[i].duration;
    if (time < 0) return i;
  }
  return 0;
}
