/** Return a source rectangle using the sheet's uneven per-column row boundaries. */
function getFrameRectangle(character, frame) {
  const facing = character.horizontalFacingOnly ? character.facing : character.direction;
  const row = character.attack
    ? character.attacks[character.attack.name].rows[character.attack.facing]
    : !character.moving && character.idleRows?.[facing] !== undefined
    ? character.idleRows[facing]
    : character.rows[facing];
  // Attack artwork can exceed the grid cell. Custom rectangles keep the tank's
  // anchor fixed even when a muzzle flash needs a wider crop.
  const custom = character.layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame];
  if (custom) return custom;
  const { columnEdges, rowEdges } = character.layout;
  return {
    x: columnEdges[frame],
    y: rowEdges[frame][row],
    width: columnEdges[frame + 1] - columnEdges[frame],
    height: rowEdges[frame][row + 1] - rowEdges[frame][row],
    footY: character.layout.footY?.[frame]?.[row] ?? rowEdges[frame][row + 1]
  };
}

/** Select a direction-specific walking cycle, or hold frame zero when idle. */
function getAnimationFrame(character) {
  if (character.attack) {
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';

// EDIT reaction distance/timing independently of normal chase speed.
export const contactSettings = {
  bounce: { distance: 52, travel: 0.18, recovery: 0.6 },
  push: { distance: 14, travel: 0.09, recovery: 0.18 },
  cooldown: 0.12,
  playerDamage: 10, // EDIT default HP lost per accepted contact hit.
  mobDamage: 1, // Basic Mob contact damage; other NPCs keep the default above.
  iFrameDuration: 0.2 // Seconds; shared protection against every overlapping enemy.
};

/** Detect player pass-through with a swept segment rather than endpoint overlap only. */
function contactGeometry(npc, player, motion) {
  const enemyBody = getCombatHitbox(npc), playerBody = getCombatHitbox(player);
  const rx = enemyBody.rx + playerBody.rx, ry = enemyBody.ry + playerBody.ry;
  const fromX = playerBody.x - motion.x, fromY = playerBody.y - motion.y;
  const lengthSquared = motion.x * motion.x + motion.y * motion.y;
  const scaledLength = (motion.x / rx) ** 2 + (motion.y / ry) ** 2;
  const t = scaledLength ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    ((enemyBody.x - fromX) * motion.x / rx ** 2 +
      (enemyBody.y - fromY) * motion.y / ry ** 2) / scaledLength)) : 1;
  const dx = enemyBody.x - (fromX + motion.x * t);
  const dy = enemyBody.y - (fromY + motion.y * t);
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const pushing = lengthSquared > 0.0001 &&
    motion.x * (npc.x - fromX) + motion.y * (npc.y - fromY) > 0;
  // At exact overlap, push along player travel; otherwise away from the player.
  const fallbackLength = Math.hypot(motion.x, motion.y) || 1;
  const nx = distance > 0.001 ? dx / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.x / fallbackLength : 1;
  const ny = distance > 0.001 ? dy / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.y / fallbackLength : 0;
  const radius = 1 / Math.hypot(nx / rx, ny / ry);
  return { touching: (dx / rx) ** 2 + (dy / ry) ** 2 < 1, pushing, radius, nx, ny,
    overlap: Math.max(0, radius - Math.hypot(enemyBody.x - playerBody.x, enemyBody.y - playerBody.y)) };
}

/** React to contact, flash once, and pause chase until bounce/push recovery ends. */
export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move) {
  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0)) {
    const baseDamage = npc.contactDamage ?? (npc.type === 'mob' ? contactSettings.mobDamage : contactSettings.playerDamage);
    damagePlayer(player, baseDamage * (npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1));
    player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;
  }
  const overrideBounce = npc.contactReaction?.kind === 'bounce' && hit.pushing;
  if (hit.touching && ((!npc.contactReaction && !npc.contactCooldown) || overrideBounce)) {
    const kind = hit.pushing ? 'push' : 'bounce';
    const settings = contactSettings[kind];
    const overlap = hit.overlap;
    npc.contactReaction = {
      kind, elapsed: 0, nx: hit.nx, ny: hit.ny,
      distance: settings.distance + overlap, applied: 0
    };
    npc.attack = null;
  }
  const reaction = npc.contactReaction;
  if (!reaction) return false;
  const settings = contactSettings[reaction.kind];
  reaction.elapsed += delta;
  const t = Math.min(1, reaction.elapsed / settings.travel);
  const distance = reaction.distance * (1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t));
  const step = distance - reaction.applied;
  move(npc, reaction.nx * step, reaction.ny * step);
  reaction.applied = distance;
  const pauseChase = npc.contactRecoveryDelay !== false;
  if (pauseChase) npc.moving = false;
  const recovery = pauseChase ? settings.recovery : settings.travel;
  if (reaction.elapsed >= recovery) {
    npc.contactReaction = null;
    npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
  }
  // Bosses still recoil/flash, but do not skip their AI update or wait afterward.
  return pauseChase;
}

function updateCharacter(character, delta, direction, chaseTarget) {
  if (character.attack) {
    character.attack.elapsed += delta * 1000;
    const attack = character.attacks[character.attack.name];
    const frames = character.layout.columnEdges.length - 1;
    if (character.attack.elapsed >= frames * attack.frameDuration) {
      const walkElapsed = character.attack.walkElapsed;
      beginPoseTransition(character);
      character.attack = null;
      character.elapsed = walkElapsed;
      updateAttackControls();
    } else {
      return;
    }
  }
  character.moving = Boolean(direction);
  if (!direction) {
    character.elapsed = 0;
    return;
  }

  // Arona turns at the current stride phase rather than snapping to frame zero.
  if (character.direction !== direction && !character.preserveWalkPhase) {
    character.elapsed = 0;
  }
  character.direction = direction;
  if (character.horizontalFacingOnly) {
    const horizontal = directionVectors[direction][0];
    if (horizontal) {
      const facing = horizontal > 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
      if (facing !== character.facing) beginPoseTransition(character);
      character.facing = facing;
    }
  }
  character.elapsed += delta * 1000;
  // Chase uses the precise center-to-center vector; facing stays eight-way.
  const [x, y] = chaseTarget
    ? [chaseTarget.x - character.x, chaseTarget.y - character.y]
    : directionVectors[direction];
  const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
  const baseSpeed = movementSpeed * (character.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(character, 'spdPercent');
  const step = Math.max(baseSpeed, character.catchupSpeed || 0) * delta;
  const distance = (chaseTarget ? Math.min(step, length) : step) / (length || 1);
  const previousX = character.x;
  const previousY = character.y;

// Visual remnants are separate from living NPCs: no AI, collisions, or rewards.
const deaths = new Map();
const gachaEffects = new Map();
let gachaIcon;
export const deathSettings = { duration: 0.38, fadeStart: 0.12, distance: 48 };
export const gachaSettings = { rise: 0.24, hold: 0.1, pop: 0.16, width: 38 };

/** Load the supplied gacha artwork before the preview begins. */
export function loadEnemyDeathGraphics() {
  gachaIcon = new Image();
  gachaIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/Gacha_Ticket.png';
  return gachaIcon.decode();
}

/** Calculate a fast eased rise, brief stop, then expansion and disappearance. */
export function gachaPose(effect) {
  const rise = Math.min(1, effect.elapsed / gachaSettings.rise);
  const pop = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    (effect.elapsed - gachaSettings.rise - gachaSettings.hold) / gachaSettings.pop));
  return { x: effect.x, y: effect.y - effect.height * (1 - (1 - rise) ** 3),
    scale: 0.75 + 0.25 * rise + 0.65 * pop,
    opacity: 1 - pop, behind: rise < 0.55 };
}

/** Freeze the defeated pose and launch it away from the source of the hit. */
export function beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source) {
  const dx = source ? enemy.x - source.x : enemy.contactReaction?.nx ?? 1;
  const dy = source ? enemy.y - source.y : enemy.contactReaction?.ny ?? 0;
  const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const death = { elapsed: 0, originX: enemy.x, originY: enemy.y,
    nx: length ? dx / length : 1, ny: length ? dy / length : 0, opacity: 1 };
  deaths.set(enemy.id, { ...enemy, death, transition: null, moving: false });
  gachaEffects.set(enemy.id, { x: enemy.x, y: enemy.y, elapsed: 0,
    height: (enemy.spriteSize || 112) / 2 + 28 });
}

/** Advance every remnant, including offscreen ones, and remove after the fade. */
export function updateEnemyDeaths(delta) {
  for (const [id, effect] of gachaEffects) {
    effect.elapsed += delta;
    }
  }
  return removed;
}

/** At 90% capacity, remove farthest non-bosses until population reaches 70%. */
export function trimEnemyPopulation(player) {
  const settings = enemyPopulationSettings;
  if (enemies.size < Math.ceil(settings.limit * settings.trimAt)) return 0;
  const target = Math.floor(settings.limit * settings.trimTo);
  const candidates = [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy => !isBossEnemy(enemy))
    .sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(b.x - player.x, b.y - player.y) - Math.hypot(a.x - player.x, a.y - player.y));
  let removed = 0;
  for (const enemy of candidates) {
    if (enemies.size <= target) break;
    enemies.delete(enemy.id);
    removed++;
  }
  return removed;
}

// EDIT Yuuka testing balance here; automatic encounter frequency is not assigned yet.
export const yuukaSettings = { speed: 336, hitCredits: 1, deathCredits: 100,
  burstRadiusMultiplier: 1.3, turnMin: 0.12, turnMax: 0.35, roamRadius: 500 };

/** Scale spawn-time HP from the player's normal attack damage, excluding critical rolls. */
export function yuukaHealth(playerDamage) {
  return Math.max(1, Math.round((Math.max(0, playerDamage) + 100) / 100 * 900));
}

/** Frequently change heading, steering back toward the player when wandering too far. */
export function yuukaMotion(enemy, player, delta, random = Math.random) {
  enemy.erraticTimer = (enemy.erraticTimer || 0) - delta;
  if (enemy.erraticTimer <= 0) {
    enemy.erraticTimer = yuukaSettings.turnMin + random() * (yuukaSettings.turnMax - yuukaSettings.turnMin);
    const dx = player.x - enemy.x, dy = player.y - enemy.y;
    enemy.erraticAngle = Math.hypot(dx, dy) > yuukaSettings.roamRadius
      ? Math.atan2(dy, dx) + (random() - 0.5) * 2 : random() * Math.PI * 2;
  }
  const angle = enemy.erraticAngle;
  const names = ['right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft','up','upRight'];
  return { direction: names[(Math.round(angle / (Math.PI / 4)) + 8) % 8],
    target: { x: enemy.x + Math.cos(angle) * 10000, y: enemy.y + Math.sin(angle) * 10000 } };
}
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT elite display scale relative to a normal Mob (20% larger than the former 1.5x).
export const eliteSizeMultiplier = 1.8;
export const eliteChance = 0.01;
export const mobBaseHp = 60;
export const shirokoBossStats = { hpMultiplier: 100, contactDamage: 10 };

/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random) {
  const elite = type === 'mob' && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteChance));
  const baseHp = type === 'mob' ? mobBaseHp
    : type === 'shiroko' ? mobBaseHp * shirokoBossStats.hpMultiplier : 100;
  const maxHp = baseHp * (elite ? 10 : 1);
  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite ? eliteSizeMultiplier : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : undefined,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1
  };
}
import { bossSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { getAllEnemies, isBossEnemy, onEnemySpawn, onEnemyDefeat } from './world-state.js';
import { offscreenSpawnPoint } from './playtest-spawner.js';

export const bossSpawnSettings = { unlockKills: 1000, baseChance: 0.0001, pityStart: 2500,
  guaranteedKills: 3000, retryInterval: 1, placementAttempts: 30, thirdBossUnlockKills: 5000 };

/** Endless kill totals are separate from the boss-charge counter. */
export function bossWaveLimit(endlessKills) {
  return endlessKills >= bossSpawnSettings.thirdBossUnlockKills ? 3 : 2;
}

/** Pick distinct bosses only; missing future roster entries never become duplicates. */
export function selectBossWave(stage, endless, endlessKills, roster, random = Math.random) {
  const available = [...new Set(roster)];
  if (!endless) {
    const preferred = bossTypeForStage(stage, random);
    return available.includes(preferred) ? [preferred] : available.slice(0, 1);
  }
  for (let i = available.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
    [available[i], available[j]] = [available[j], available[i]];
  }
  return available.slice(0, bossWaveLimit(endlessKills));
}

/** Stage 1 always uses Shiroko; unassigned stages retain the current test roster. */
export function bossTypeForStage(stage, random = Math.random) {
  return stage.id === 'first' ? 'shiroko' : random() < 0.5 ? 'iroha' : 'shiroko';
}

/** Chance per eligible kill; linearly rise from 0.01% after 2500 to 100% at 3000. */
export function bossChance(kills) {
  const settings = bossSpawnSettings;
  if (kills < settings.unlockKills) return 0;
  const pity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    (kills - settings.pityStart) / (settings.guaranteedKills - settings.pityStart)));
  return settings.baseChance + (1 - settings.baseChance) * pity;
}

/** Keep progression separate from total run kills and freeze it while bosses live. */
export function createBossCharge(random = Math.random) {
  let kills = 0, pending = false;
  return {
    recordDefeat(bossWasAlive) {
      if (bossWasAlive || pending) return;
      kills++;
      const chance = bossChance(kills);
      if (chance > 0 && (chance >= 1 || random() < chance)) pending = true;
    },
    reset() { kills = 0; pending = false; },
    get kills() { return kills; },
    get pending() { return pending; },
    get chance() { return bossChance(kills); }
  };
}

/** Spawn an offscreen chasing boss after a successful kill roll, retrying blocked spots. */
import { isBossEnemy } from './world-state.js';

export const playtestSpawnSettings = {
  perSecond: 5, maxPerSecond: 8, nearbyRadius: 400, nearbyTarget: 40,
  crowdedPerSecond: 1, visibleLimit: 50,
  offscreenMargin: 100, placementAttempts: 30, leastCrowdedChance: 0.9, streamJitter: 0.15
};

/** Count enemies whose sprite area intersects the actual gameplay viewport. */
export function visibleEnemyCount(enemies, camera, width, height) {
  return enemies.filter(enemy => {
    const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || 112) / 2;
    return enemy.x + radius >= camera.x && enemy.x - radius <= camera.x + width &&
      enemy.y + radius >= camera.y && enemy.y - radius <= camera.y + height;
  }).length;
}

/** Increase arrivals from 5 to 8/s as the crowd within 400px becomes sparse. */
export function adaptiveSpawnRate(enemies, player, visible) {
  if (visible >= playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit) return playtestSpawnSettings.crowdedPerSecond;
  const nearby = enemies.filter(enemy =>
    Math.hypot(enemy.x - player.x, enemy.y - player.y) <= playtestSpawnSettings.nearbyRadius).length;
  const density = Math.min(1, nearby / playtestSpawnSettings.nearbyTarget);
  return Math.round(playtestSpawnSettings.perSecond +
    (playtestSpawnSettings.maxPerSecond - playtestSpawnSettings.perSecond) * (1 - density));
}

/** Rank legal entrances by enemy count relative to the player; randomize ties. */
export function leastCrowdedSides(stage, enemies, player, random = Math.random) {
  const sides = stage.availableSides || ['left', 'right', 'top', 'bottom'];
  const counts = Object.fromEntries(sides.map(side => [side, 0]));
  for (const enemy of enemies) {
    const dx = enemy.x - player.x, dy = enemy.y - player.y;
    if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) continue;
    const side = stage.axis === 'horizontal' ? (dx < 0 ? 'left' : 'right')
      : stage.axis === 'vertical' ? (dy < 0 ? 'top' : 'bottom')
      : Math.abs(dx) >= Math.abs(dy) ? (dx < 0 ? 'left' : 'right') : (dy < 0 ? 'top' : 'bottom');
import { isBossEnemy, enemyViewportDistance } from './world-state.js';
import { statMultiplier } from './combat-stats.js';

export const bossCatchupSettings = { distance: 150, baseMultiplier: 2, playerMultiplier: 1.35, extraSpeed: 60 };

/** Boost distant chasing bosses above player speed until their sprite re-enters view. */
export function updateBossCatchup(enemy, player, camera, width, height, baseSpeed = 180) {
  if (!isBossEnemy(enemy)) return;
  const distance = enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height);
  if (distance > bossCatchupSettings.distance) enemy.catchingUp = true;
  if (distance === 0) enemy.catchingUp = false;
  const playerSpeed = baseSpeed * (player.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(player, 'spdPercent');
  const enemySpeed = baseSpeed * (enemy.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(enemy, 'spdPercent');
  enemy.catchupSpeed = enemy.catchingUp && enemy.ai && enemy.behavior === 'chase'
    ? Math.max(enemySpeed * bossCatchupSettings.baseMultiplier,
      playerSpeed * bossCatchupSettings.playerMultiplier + bossCatchupSettings.extraSpeed) : 0;
}
// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.
export const defaultCombatStats = { atkPercent: 0, spdPercent: 0, critPercent: 0, pickupPercent: 0, hastePercent: 0 };

/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  return 1 + Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0) / 100;
}

/** Roll critical hits per enemy hit; critical damage is twice normal damage. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, baseDamage, random = Math.random) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const critical = random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent)) / 100;
  return { damage: Math.max(1, Math.round(baseDamage * statMultiplier(character, 'atkPercent') * (critical ? 2 : 1))),
    critical, type: critical ? 'critical' : 'normal' };
}

// EDIT the starting cost and base term of the rounded per-level increase.
export const startingLevelExp = 50;
export const expIncreasePerLevel = 15;

/** Add round(15 + currentLevel / 2) to the next requirement on each level-up. */
export function experienceForLevel(level) {
  const current = Math.max(1, Math.floor(level));
  // Sum rounded increments for levels 1..current-1 without a per-level loop.
  const steps = current - 1;
  const pairs = Math.floor(steps / 2);
  const roundedHalves = pairs * (pairs + 1) + (steps % 2 ? pairs + 1 : 0);
  return startingLevelExp + expIncreasePerLevel * steps + roundedHalves;
}

/** Initialize session stats once; Development defaults to invincibility on. */
export function ensurePlayerStats(character) {
  character.level ??= 1;
  character.exp ??= 0;
  character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
  character.maxHp ??= 100;
  character.hp ??= character.maxHp;
  character.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(character.maxHp, character.shield ?? 0));
  character.invincible ??= true;
  ensureCombatStats(character);
  return character;
}

/** Add experience, retaining overflow and supporting multiple level-ups per award. */
export function addPlayerExp(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  character.exp += Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(amount));
  while (character.exp >= character.maxExp) {
    character.exp -= character.maxExp;
    character.level++;
    character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
    character.hp = character.maxHp; // Every level-up fully restores health.
  }
}

  ensurePlayerStats(character);

export function rollEnemyExp(random = Math.random, elite = false) {
  if (elite) {
    return random() < 0.8 ? 11 + Math.floor(random() * 10) : 21 + Math.floor(random() * 29);
  }
  const uncommon = random() >= 0.9;
  return uncommon ? 11 + Math.floor(random() * 10) : 1 + Math.floor(random() * 9);
}

/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
export function getExpDrops() {
  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
}

export const eliteExpRewards = { count: 5, minimumTotal: 150 };

/** Top up low elite rolls, preferring existing high tiers before promoting others. */
export function rollEliteReports(random = Math.random, override) {
  const values = Array.from({ length: eliteExpRewards.count }, () =>
    Math.max(11, Math.floor(override ?? rollEnemyExp(random, true))));
  let deficit = eliteExpRewards.minimumTotal - values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const indices = values.map((_, index) => index).sort((a, b) => values[b] - values[a]);
  for (const index of indices) {
    if (deficit <= 0) break;
    const extra = Math.min(deficit, Math.max(0, 49 - values[index]));
    values[index] += extra;
    deficit -= extra;
  }
  return values;
}

// EDIT boss reward amount, minimum report count, and outward burst radius here.
export const bossExpRewards = { minLevels: 0.8, maxLevels: 1.5, minimumReports: 50,
  minDistance: 92, maxDistance: 211.6 };

/** Split a level-scaled boss reward into positive reports without losing EXP. */
export function rollBossReports(player, random = Math.random) {
  const requirement = experienceForLevel(player?.level || 1);
  const minimum = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports,
    Math.ceil(requirement * bossExpRewards.minLevels));
  const maximum = Math.max(minimum, Math.floor(requirement * bossExpRewards.maxLevels));
  const total = minimum + Math.floor(random() * (maximum - minimum + 1));
  const count = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total / 49));
  const base = Math.floor(total / count), remainder = total % count;
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));
}

/** Divide player level by (2 + report tier), add 3, then round halves upward. */
export function standardMobExp(player, tier = 0) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.floor(player?.level || 1));
  const reportLevel = Math.max(0, Math.min(3, Math.floor(tier)));
  return Math.round(3 + level / (2 + reportLevel));
}

/** Drop a full-circle boss burst, five elite reports, or one ordinary report. */
export function dropEnemyExp(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  if (enemy.type === 'yuuka') return []; // Credit enemy rewards credits instead of reports.
  const reports = [];
  const boss = enemy.boss === true || ['iroha', 'shiroko'].includes(enemy.type);
  // Roll artwork first so its tier bonus does not depend on the resulting EXP.
  const standardMob = enemy.type === 'mob' && !boss && !enemy.elite && enemy.expReward == null;
  const mobTier = standardMob ? (random() < 0.9 ? 0 : 1) : undefined;
  const values = boss ? rollBossReports(getActivePlayer(), random) : enemy.elite ? rollEliteReports(random, enemy.expReward)
    : [Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? (enemy.type === 'mob'
      ? standardMobExp(getActivePlayer(), mobTier) : rollEnemyExp(random)))];
  const burstAngle = boss ? random() * Math.PI * 2 : 0;
  for (const [index, value] of values.entries()) {
    const drop = dropExpReport(enemy, random, value, mobTier);
    if (!drop) continue;
    if (boss) {
      // One report per angular sector guarantees coverage in every direction.
      const angle = burstAngle + (index + random() * 0.5) / values.length * Math.PI * 2;
      const distance = bossExpRewards.minDistance + random() *
        (bossExpRewards.maxDistance - bossExpRewards.minDistance);
      drop.scatter.dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
      drop.scatter.dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
      constrainDropLanding(drop);
    }
    reports.push(drop);
  }
  return reports;
}

// enemy-death settings (see FORMULAS.md for meanings).
export const deathSettings = { duration: 0.38, fadeStart: 0.12, distance: 48 };
export const gachaSettings = { rise: 0.24, hold: 0.1, pop: 0.16, width: 38 };

/** Full EXP required at level L: 50 + sum(round(15 + k/2)), k=1..L-1. */
export function levelExpFormula(level) {
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.floor(level)) - 1;
  if (progressionSettings.increaseDivisor === 2) {
    const pairs = Math.floor(steps / 2);
    return startingLevelExp + expIncreasePerLevel * steps +
      pairs * (pairs + 1) + (steps % 2 ? pairs + 1 : 0);
  }
  let total = startingLevelExp;
  for (let k = 1; k <= steps; k++) total += Math.round(expIncreasePerLevel + k / progressionSettings.increaseDivisor);
  return total;
}

/** Standard Mob report: round(3 + playerLevel / (2 + reportTier)). */
export function mobExpFormula(level, tier) {
  return Math.round(reportSettings.mobBase + Math.max(1, Math.floor(level)) /
    (reportSettings.mobDivisor + Math.max(0, Math.min(3, Math.floor(tier)))));
}

/** Yuuka spawn HP: round((normal player damage + 100) / 100 * 900). */
export const yuukaHpSettings = { offset: 100, divisor: 100, base: 900 };
export function yuukaHpFormula(damage) {
  return Math.max(1, Math.round((Math.max(0, damage) + yuukaHpSettings.offset) /
    yuukaHpSettings.divisor * yuukaHpSettings.base));
}

/** ATK/SPD/PICKUP/Haste percent bonus multiplier (25% -> 1.25). */
export function percentBonusFormula(percent) {
  return 1 + Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(Number(percent)) ? Number(percent) : 0) / 100;
}

/** Damage = round(base * ATK multiplier * critical multiplier). */
export function attackDamageFormula(base, atkPercent, critical = false) {
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(base * percentBonusFormula(atkPercent) *
    (critical ? combatBalance.criticalMultiplier : 1)));
}

/** Crowd-adjusted arrivals: 8/s empty -> 5/s at40 nearby; 1/s at50 visible. */
export function spawnRateFormula(nearby, visible) {
  const s = playtestSpawnSettings;
  if (visible >= s.visibleLimit) return s.crowdedPerSecond;
  return Math.round(s.perSecond + (s.maxPerSecond - s.perSecond) *
    (1 - Math.min(1, nearby / s.nearbyTarget)));
}

/** Boss chance per eligible kill; charge freezes while any boss is alive. */
export function bossChanceFormula(kills) {
  const s = bossSpawnSettings;
  if (kills < s.unlockKills) return 0;
  const pity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (kills - s.pityStart) / (s.guaranteedKills - s.pityStart)));
  return s.baseChance + (1 - s.baseChance) * pity;
}

/** Format normal hits, yellow critical hits, or red supercrit visuals. */
export function damageNumberStyle(amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
  const text = String(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100);
  if (player) return { text, color: '#ff5265', italic: false };
  if (hitType === 'supercritical') return { text: `${text}!!!`, color: '#ff5265', italic: true };
  if (hitType === 'critical') return { text: `${text}!`, color: '#ffe15a', italic: true };
  return { text, color: '#ffffff', italic: false };
}

/** Queue a damage popup; supercritical styling does not define its trigger. */
export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
  if (!(amount > 0) || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
  if (numbers.length >= damageNumberSettings.maxCount) numbers.shift();
  numbers.push({ ...damageNumberStyle(amount, player, hitType), elapsed: 0,
    x: target.x, y: target.y - (target.spriteSize || 112) * 0.4,
    drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
}

  const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart) /
    (damageNumberSettings.duration - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart)));
  return { x: number.x + number.drift * t,

/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
export function getExpDrops() {
  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
}



/** Top up low elite rolls, preferring existing high tiers before promoting others. */
export function rollEliteReports(random = Math.random, override) {
  const values = Array.from({ length: eliteExpRewards.count }, () =>
    Math.max(reportSettings.secondMin, Math.floor(override ?? rollEnemyExp(random, true))));
  let deficit = eliteExpRewards.minimumTotal - values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const indices = values.map((_, index) => index).sort((a, b) => values[b] - values[a]);
  for (const index of indices) {
    if (deficit <= 0) break;
    const extra = Math.min(deficit, Math.max(0, reportSettings.thirdMax - values[index]));
    values[index] += extra;
    deficit -= extra;
  }
  return values;
}

// Boss reward settings live in game-config.js.


/** Split a level-scaled boss reward into positive reports without losing EXP. */
export function rollBossReports(player, random = Math.random) {
  const requirement = experienceForLevel(player?.level || 1);
  const minimum = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports,
    Math.ceil(requirement * bossExpRewards.minLevels));
  const maximum = Math.max(minimum, Math.floor(requirement * bossExpRewards.maxLevels));
  const total = minimum + Math.floor(random() * (maximum - minimum + 1));
  const count = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total / reportSettings.thirdMax));
  const base = Math.floor(total / count), remainder = total % count;
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));
}

/** Divide player level by (2 + report tier), add 3, then round halves upward. */
export function standardMobExp(player, tier = 0) {
  return mobExpFormula(player?.level || 1, tier);
}

/** Install session-only NPC spawning, inspection, deletion, and basic test AI. */
export function createNpcTools({ canvas, characters, camera, getPlayer, getPlayerDamage = () => 23, isVertical = () => false,
  isFreeScroll = () => false, isPlacementClear = () => true,
  updateCharacter, drawCharacter, moveNpcBy, baseMovementSpeed = 180, allowMultipleBosses = () => false, getBossLimit }) {
  const panel = document.querySelector('#npc-tools');
  const oneHpToggle = panel.querySelector('#enemy-one-hp');
  oneHpToggle.checked = enemyTestConfig.oneHp;
  oneHpToggle.disabled = true; // Read-only: this configuration follows admin seed 0.
  for (const [id, key] of [['contact-player-damage', 'playerDamage'], ['contact-mob-damage', 'mobDamage']]) {
    document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change', event => {
      const value = Number(event.target.value);
      if (Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 1 && value <= 1000000) contactSettings[key] = Math.floor(value);
      event.target.value = contactSettings[key];
    });
  }
  const field = name => panel.querySelector(`[name="${name}"]`);
  const list = field('npc-selection');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#npc-feedback');
  let counter = 0;
  let selectedId = '';
  let paused = false;
  let step = false;
  // Both backgrounds share one population: switching maps never replaces NPCs.
  const records = () => getAllEnemies();
  const visible = (margin = 160) => records().filter(npc =>
    npc.x >= camera.x - margin && npc.x <= camera.x + canvas.width + margin &&
    npc.y >= camera.y - margin && npc.y <= camera.y + canvas.height + margin);
  const cap = enemyPopulationSettings.limit;
  const eliteButton = panel.querySelector('#spawn-elite-npc');
  /** Elite variants currently exist for basic Mob enemies only. */
  function updateEliteButton() {
      drawCharacter(npc);
    }
    if (!bossLayer) drawGachaDeaths(context, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, false);
  }

  refresh();
  /** Clean up before spawning, or immediately after entering another map. */
  function cleanup() {
    let removed = trimEnemyPopulation(getPlayer());
    removed += despawnDistantEnemies(camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, isPlacementClear);
    if (removed) refresh();
    return removed;
  }

  return { update, draw: () => draw(false), drawBosses: () => draw(true), refresh, cleanup, getEnemies: records,
    slotsRemaining: () => Math.max(0, cap - records().length),
    spawnBoss: (type, x, y) => spawn(x, y, { type, variant: 'normal', ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true }),
    spawnEnemy: (x, y) => spawn(x, y, { type: 'mob', variant: 'random', ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true }) };

/** Scale spawn-time HP from the player's normal attack damage, excluding critical rolls. */
export function yuukaHealth(playerDamage) {
  return yuukaHpFormula(playerDamage);
}

/** Frequently change heading, steering back toward the player when wandering too far. */
export function yuukaMotion(enemy, player, delta, random = Math.random) {
  enemy.erraticTimer = (enemy.erraticTimer || 0) - delta;
  if (enemy.erraticTimer <= 0) {
    enemy.erraticTimer = yuukaSettings.turnMin + random() * (yuukaSettings.turnMax - yuukaSettings.turnMin);

    enemy.erraticAngle = Math.hypot(dx, dy) > yuukaSettings.roamRadius

  return [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy =>

/** Remove an enemy deliberately, for example after a confirmed defeat. */
export function removeEnemy(id) {
  enemies.delete(id);
}

/** Free population slots without kills, loot or death effects when enemies leave play. */
export function despawnDistantEnemies(camera, width, height, isPlayable) {
  let removed = 0;
  for (const [id, enemy] of enemies) {
    if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) continue;
    if (enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height) > enemyPopulationSettings.despawnDistance ||
        !isPlayable(enemy, enemy.x, enemy.y)) {
      enemies.delete(id);
      removed++;
    }
  }
  return removed;
}

/** At 90% capacity, remove farthest non-bosses until population reaches 70%. */
export function trimEnemyPopulation(player) {
  const settings = enemyPopulationSettings;
  if (enemies.size < Math.ceil(settings.limit * settings.trimAt)) return 0;
  const target = Math.floor(settings.limit * settings.trimTo);
  const candidates = [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy => !isBossEnemy(enemy))
    .sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(b.x - player.x, b.y - player.y) - Math.hypot(a.x - player.x, a.y - player.y));
  let removed = 0;
  for (const enemy of candidates) {
    if (enemies.size <= target) break;
    enemies.delete(enemy.id);
    removed++;
  }
  return removed;
}
import { yuukaSpawnChanceFormula, yuukaSpawnSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { yuukaHpFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { yuukaSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { yuukaSettings } from './game-config.js';
// Balance and automatic spawn probability live in game-config.js.


/** Scale spawn-time HP from the player's normal attack damage, excluding critical rolls. */
export function yuukaHealth(playerDamage) {
  return yuukaHpFormula(playerDamage);
}

/** Frequently change heading, steering back toward the player when wandering too far. */
export function yuukaMotion(enemy, player, delta, random = Math.random) {
  enemy.erraticTimer = (enemy.erraticTimer || 0) - delta;
  if (enemy.erraticTimer <= 0) {
    enemy.erraticTimer = yuukaSettings.turnMin + random() * (yuukaSettings.turnMax - yuukaSettings.turnMin);
    const dx = player.x - enemy.x, dy = player.y - enemy.y;
    enemy.erraticAngle = Math.hypot(dx, dy) > yuukaSettings.roamRadius
      ? Math.atan2(dy, dx) + (random() - 0.5) * 2 : random() * Math.PI * 2;
  }
  const angle = enemy.erraticAngle;
  const names = ['right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft','up','upRight'];
  return { direction: names[(Math.round(angle / (Math.PI / 4)) + 8) % 8],
    target: { x: enemy.x + Math.cos(angle) * 10000, y: enemy.y + Math.sin(angle) * 10000 } };
}

/** Track eligible kills since Yuuka last spawned; successful spawns reset cooldown and pity. */
export function createYuukaSpawnCharge() {
  let kills = 0;
  let hasSpawned = false;
  return {
    recordKill() { kills++; },
    recordSpawn() { kills = 0; hasSpawned = true; },
    get kills() { return kills; },
    get remainingCooldown() { return hasSpawned ? Math.max(0, yuukaSpawnSettings.cooldownKills - kills) : 0; },
    get chance() { return yuukaSpawnChanceFormula(kills, hasSpawned); },
    roll(random = Math.random) { return this.remainingCooldown === 0 && random() < this.chance; }
  };
}
  function update(delta, playerMotion = { x: 0, y: 0 }) {
    updateEnemyDeaths(delta); // Finish visual fades even while AI is paused.
    const time = step ? 1 / 60 : paused ? 0 : delta;
    step = false;
    const player = getPlayer();
    // Tick once per simulation update, never once per enemy or contact check.
    player.contactIFrames = Math.max(0, (player.contactIFrames || 0) - time);
    const names = ['up', 'upRight', 'right', 'downRight', 'down', 'downLeft', 'left', 'upLeft'];
    for (const npc of records()) {
      updateBossCatchup(npc, player, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, baseMovementSpeed);
      advanceDamageFlash(npc, delta);
      if (npc.animationFrames) npc.gifElapsed = (npc.gifElapsed || 0) + delta * 1000;
      if (time && updateNpcContact(npc, player, playerMotion, time, moveNpcBy)) continue;
      let direction;
      let chaseTarget;
      if (time && npc.ai) {
        if (npc.behavior === 'erratic') {
          const motion = yuukaMotion(npc, player, time);
          direction = motion.direction;
          chaseTarget = motion.target;
        } else if (npc.behavior === 'chase') {
          const targetX = player.x + (npc.chaseOffsetX || 0);
          const targetY = player.y + (npc.chaseOffsetY || 0);
          const dx = targetX - npc.x, dy = targetY - npc.y;
          // Chase the center exactly; quantize only the animation facing.
          // Physical movement uses the full target vector, including small gaps.
          if (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0) {
            const angle = Math.atan2(dx, -dy);
            direction = names[(Math.round(angle / (Math.PI / 4)) + 8) % 8];
            chaseTarget = { x: targetX, y: targetY };
          }
        } else if (npc.behavior === 'wander') {
          npc.wanderTimer -= time;
          if (npc.wanderTimer <= 0) {
            npc.wanderTimer = 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.5;
            npc.wanderDirection = names[Math.floor(Math.random() * names.length)];
          }
          direction = npc.wanderDirection;
        }
      }
      if (time) {
        if (npc.transition) npc.transition.elapsed += time * 1000;
        updateCharacter(npc, time, direction, chaseTarget);
        // A chasing NPC can reach contact during this step, even with a stationary player.
        updateNpcContact(npc, player, playerMotion, 0, moveNpcBy);
      }
    }
    const selected = getEnemy(selectedId);
    document.querySelector('#npc-inspector').textContent = selected
      ? `${selected.id} | X ${selected.x.toFixed(1)} Y ${selected.y.toFixed(1)} | HP ${selected.hp}/${selected.maxHp} | AI ${selected.ai ? selected.behavior : 'off'}`
      : 'No NPC selected.';
  }

  /** Cull rendering only; sprite outlines use the shared Sprite Bounds toggle. */
  function draw(bossLayer = false) {
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!bossLayer) drawGachaDeaths(context, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, true);
    const remnants = getEnemyDeaths().filter(npc =>
      npc.x >= camera.x - 300 && npc.x <= camera.x + canvas.width + 300 &&
      npc.y >= camera.y - 300 && npc.y <= camera.y + canvas.height + 300);

// Yuuka rolls on each regular enemy arrival, not on boss spawn attempts.
export const yuukaSpawnSettings = { baseChance: 0.005, cooldownKills: 100,
  pityStart: 500, pityStepKills: 50, pityStepChance: 0.01, maxChance: 0.05 };

/** Chance after cooldown: .5%, plus 1 percentage point at 550, 600, ... kills. */
export function yuukaSpawnChanceFormula(kills, hasSpawned = false) {
  const settings = yuukaSpawnSettings;
  if (hasSpawned && kills < settings.cooldownKills) return 0;
  const steps = Math.floor(Math.max(0, kills - settings.pityStart) / settings.pityStepKills);
  return Math.min(settings.maxChance, settings.baseChance + steps * settings.pityStepChance);
}

export const creditDropChance = 1 / 90;
export const secretNoteDropChance = 0.001;

import { trackVolumeScale } from './game-config.js';
export { trackVolumeScale } from './game-config.js';
// Stream only the current and fading-out music; never decode whole long tracks.
export const mapTracks = {
  first: 'stage 1 - Feverdream.mp3',
  second: 'stage 2 - PAN PAKA PANNNNNNNNN!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!.mp3',
  third: 'Stage 3 - new years.mp3',
  fourth: 'stage 4 - USAGI FLAP.mp3'
};

// Per-track source volume at 100% on the master slider.


/** Manage gesture-started looping music, volume, and map-change crossfades. */
export function createMapAudio(initialMap) {
  const slider = document.querySelector('#music-volume');
  const output = document.querySelector('#music-volume-value');
  const button = document.querySelector('#music-toggle');
  const status = document.querySelector('#music-status');
  const fadeDuration = 900; // EDIT milliseconds to match the checkerboard ripple.
  const tracks = new Map();
  let mapId = initialMap;
  let volume = Number(slider.value) / 100;
  let enabled = true;
  let unlocked = false;
  let disposed = false;
  let blocked = false;

  /** Stop, rewind, and release the media source once its fade has finished. */
  function stopTrack(id, track) {
    track.audio.pause();
    track.audio.currentTime = 0;
    track.audio.removeAttribute('src');
    track.audio.load();
    tracks.delete(id);
  }

  /** Start only the selected map track, fading every previous one toward silence. */
  function selectTrack() {
    for (const track of tracks.values()) {
      track.from = track.gain;
      track.target = 0;
      track.elapsed = 0;
    }
    if (!unlocked || !enabled || disposed) return;
    let track = tracks.get(mapId);
    if (!track) {
      const audio = new Audio();
      audio.preload = 'none';
      audio.loop = true;
      audio.volume = 0;
      audio.src = `../Audio/${encodeURIComponent(mapTracks[mapId])}`;
      track = { audio, gain: 0, from: 0, target: 1, elapsed: 0, volumeScale: trackVolumeScale[mapId] };
      tracks.set(mapId, track);
      const trackMap = mapId;
      audio.addEventListener('error', () => {
        if (mapId === trackMap) status.textContent = `Could not load ${mapTracks[trackMap]}.`;
      });
    }
    track.from = track.gain;
    track.target = 1;
    track.elapsed = 0;
    const selectedMap = mapId;
    track.audio.play().then(() => {
      if (mapId === selectedMap && enabled) {
        blocked = false;
        status.textContent = mapTracks[selectedMap];
      }
    }).catch(() => {
      if (mapId === selectedMap) {
        blocked = true;
        button.textContent = 'Play music';
        status.textContent = 'Press Play music to enable audio.';
      }
    });
  }

  /** Crossfade to a new map without keeping inactive long recordings playing. */
  function setMap(id) {
    if (!mapTracks[id] || id === mapId) return;
    mapId = id;
    selectTrack();
  }

  /** Advance smooth gains and unload tracks that are no longer in use. */
  function update(delta) {
    for (const [id, track] of tracks) {
      track.elapsed += delta * 1000;
      const t = Math.min(1, track.elapsed / fadeDuration);
      const eased = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
      track.gain = track.from + (track.target - track.from) * eased;
      track.audio.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume * track.volumeScale * track.gain));
      if (t === 1 && track.target === 0) stopTrack(id, track);
    }
  }

  /** Honor browser audio activation by starting on the first user gesture. */
  function unlock(event) {
    if (event.target?.closest?.('#music-toggle')) return;
    if (unlocked || disposed) return;
    unlocked = true;
    selectTrack();
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlock, { once: true });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', unlock, { once: true });

  slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
    volume = Number(slider.value) / 100;
    output.textContent = `${slider.value}%`;
    for (const track of tracks.values()) track.audio.volume = volume * track.volumeScale * track.gain;
  });
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    // The first explicit click enables playback; later clicks toggle it.
    if (!unlocked || blocked) { unlocked = true; enabled = true; blocked = false; }
    else enabled = !enabled;
    button.textContent = enabled ? 'Pause music' : 'Play music';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(enabled));
    selectTrack();
  });

  /** Release every track immediately when leaving the preview. */
  function stopAll() {
    disposed = true;
    for (const [id, track] of tracks) stopTrack(id, track);
  }
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', stopAll);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (!document.hidden) return;
    // Animation frames may pause in background tabs: don't leave old music playing.
    for (const [id, track] of tracks) {
      if (track.target === 0) stopTrack(id, track);
    }
  });
  output.textContent = `${slider.value}%`;
  return { setMap, update, stopAll };
}

  const scale = viewportHeight * mapSizeMultiplier / 1086;

/** Enemy recoil crosses props too, while preserving physical map boundaries. */
function moveNpcBy(character, dx, dy) {
  const targetX = character.x + dx, targetY = character.y + dy;
  let result = { x: targetX, y: targetY };
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
    result = resolveIslandMotion(character, character.x, character.y, targetX, targetY, maps.fourth, true);
  }
  if ((currentMap === 'first' || currentMap === 'second') && !mapTransition?.active) {
    const bounds = stripMapBounds(maps[currentMap], canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding);
    const margin = (character.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2;
    result.x = constrainWithoutTeleport(character.x, result.x, bounds.left + margin, bounds.right - margin);
    result.y = constrainWithoutTeleport(character.y, result.y, bounds.top + margin, bounds.bottom - margin);
  }
  character.x = result.x;
  character.y = result.y;
}
import { mapSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
export { mapSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
// Map zoom is configured independently of actors in game-config.js.


/** Physical playable limits for the enlarged horizontal/vertical strip maps. */
export function stripMapBounds(map, width, height, topPadding = 0, bottomPadding = 0) {
  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') return {
    left: -Infinity, right: Infinity,
    top: map.originY + topPadding,
    bottom: map.originY + height * mapSizeMultiplier - bottomPadding
  };
  if (map.axis !== 'vertical') return { left: -Infinity, right: Infinity, top: -Infinity, bottom: Infinity };
  return {
    left: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.leftWallRatio || 0),
    right: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.rightWallRatio ?? 1),
    top: -Infinity, bottom: Infinity
  };
}

/** Stop the camera at finite edges while leaving the long map axis infinite. */
export function clampStripCamera(map, camera, width, height) {
  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') camera.y = Math.max(map.originY,
    Math.min(map.originY + height * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.y));
  if (map.axis === 'vertical') camera.x = Math.max(map.originX,
    Math.min(map.originX + width * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.x));
}
